items.name: Alberich's Bracers
items.description:
Mad Tongue Alberich's bracers.

Set with red glintstones, said to be formed by the blood of sacrifices. Strengthen thorn sorcery.

Alberich was an aloof yet disturbed heretical sorcerer said to have been driven mad by jeering tongues during his service to the Roundtable Hold long ago.

items.name: Alberich's Pointed Hat
items.description:

Set with red glintstones, said to be formed by the blood of sacrifices. Strengthens thorn sorcery.

Alberich was an aloof yet disturbed heretical sorcerer said to have been driven mad by jeering tongues during his service to the Roundtable Hold long ago.

items.name: Albinauric Mask
items.description:
Mask made from the largely unaltered hide of a young Albinauric.

Raises arcane, but reduces the HP recovery effects of the Flask of Crimson Tears.

A far cry from godskin, this Albinauric hide mask is the product of malicious mockery.

items.name: All-Knowing Armor
items.description:
Armor set with countless eyes and ears.
Worn by Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing.

Knowledge begins with the recognition of one's ignorance. The realization that the search for knowledge is unending. But when Gideon glimpsed into the will of Queen Marika, he shuddered in fear.

At the end that should not be.

items.name: Ansbach's Attire
items.description:
Attire of Sir Ansbach. The embroidered crest of the Pureblood Knights has now all but faded away.

Slightly enhances Blood Oath and dynastic skills.

Ansbach understood that keeping his oath to his old master was not an act of logic, nor would it bear any justice, but it was for these very reasons he was unable to let go.

items.name: Ansbach's Attire (Altered)
items.description:
Attire of Sir Ansbach. Black cloth adorned with gold embroidery.

Slightly enhances Blood Oath and dynastic skills.

items.name: Ansbach's Boots
items.description:
Boots of Sir Ansbach. Black leather adorned with gold embroidery.

Slightly enhances Blood Oath and dynastic skills.

items.name: Ansbach's Manchettes
items.description:
Manchettes of Sir Ansbach. Black leather adorned with gold embroidery.

Slightly enhances Blood Oath and dynastic skills.

items.name: Aristocrat Boots
items.description:
Boots made from tanned leather.
Travel attire worn by nobles in the capital.

Abandoning their birthplace after the Shattering, these undead wanderers are the pitiful product of unending life.

items.name: Aristocrat Coat
items.description:
Tanned leather coat adorned with fine gold embroidery.
Travel attire worn by nobles in the capital, and the belonging of a family which claims a knight as an ancestor.

Abandoning their birthplace after the Shattering, these undead wanderers are the pitiful product of unending life.

items.name: Aristocrat Garb
items.description:
High quality garb adorned with fine golden embroidery.
Travel attire worn by nobles in the capital. Terribly faded and tattered.

Abandoning their birthplace after the Shattering, these undead wanderers are the pitiful product of unending life.

items.name: Aristocrat Garb (Altered)
items.description:
High quality garb adorned with fine golden embroidery.
Travel attire worn by nobles in the capital. Terribly faded and tattered.

Abandoning their birthplace after the Shattering, these undead wanderers are the pitiful product of unending life.

items.name: Aristocrat Hat
items.description:
Leather hat decorated with a withered feather.
Travel attire worn by nobles in the capital, and the belonging of a family which claims a knight as an ancestor.

Abandoning their birthplace after the Shattering, these undead wanderers are the pitiful product of unending life.

items.name: Aristocrat Headband
items.description:
Valuable headband featuring fine goldwork.
Travel attire worn by nobles in the capital.

Abandoning their birthplace after the Shattering, these undead wanderers are the pitiful product of unending life.

items.name: Armor of Night
items.description:
Bottomless black chest armor, cool to the touch.
Flowing lines in the seeming shape of a fingerprint adorn the surface. Imprisons the wearer in utterly lightless dark.

Bestowed upon those born deep underground, ordaining them as Swordhands of Night.

items.name: Armor of Solitude
items.description:
Steel chest armor of the Knights of the Solitary Gaol.
Part of a heavy armor set that covers the whole body in overlapping plates of steel, and bedecked with a black cloak.

The nameless mausoleums of the realm of shadow are said to hold the spirits of warriors who lost their names, or their hearts.

items.name: Armor of Solitude (Altered)
items.description:
Steel chest armor of the Knights of the Solitary Gaol.
Part of a heavy armor set that covers the whole body in overlapping plates of steel.

The nameless mausoleums of the realm of shadow are said to hold the spirits of warriors who lost their names, or their hearts.

items.name: Arms
items.description: Bare arms with no armor equipped.

items.name: Ascetic's Ankle Guards
items.description:
Ankle guards of the tower's ascetics which embody their commitment to an austere existence of strict self-control.

In order to ascend from their mortal flesh into tutelary deities of the land, they heighten their spirituality through severe ascetic training.

items.name: Ascetic's Loincloth
items.description:
Attire of the tower's ascetics, embodying their commitment to an austere existence of strict self-control.

In order to ascend from their mortal flesh into tutelary deities of the land, they heighten their spirituality through severe ascetic training.

items.name: Ascetic's Wrist Guards
items.description:
Wrist guards of the tower's ascetics which embody their commitment to an austere existence of strict self-control.

In order to ascend from their mortal flesh into tutelary deities of the land, they heighten their spirituality through severe ascetic training.

items.name: Ash-of-War Scarab
items.description:
Gray scarab worn directly on the head.
These scarabs roll clumps of Ashes of War during their labors.

Slightly reduces the FP cost of skills, but increases damage taken.

items.name: Astrologer Gloves
items.description:
Gloves fashioned from fine, supple cloth.
Worn by those who look to the cosmos above.

They read fate in the stars, and are said to be heirs of the glintstone sorcerers.

But alas, the night sky no longer cradles fate.

items.name: Astrologer Hood
items.description:
Hood fashioned from supple cloth.
Worn by those who look to the cosmos above.

They read fate in the stars, and are said to be heirs of the glintstone sorcerers.

But alas, the night sky no longer cradles fate.

items.name: Astrologer Robe
items.description:
Robe fashioned from supple cloth.
Worn by those who look to the cosmos above.

They read fate in the stars, and are said to be heirs of the glintstone sorcerers.

But alas, the night sky no longer cradles fate.

items.description:

Worn by those who look to the cosmos above.

They read fate in the stars, and are said to be heirs of the glintstone sorcerers.

items.name: Astrologer Trousers
items.description:
Trousers worn inside a robe.
Worn by those who look to the cosmos above.

They read fate in the stars, and are said to be heirs of the glintstone sorcerers.

But alas, the night sky no longer cradles fate.

items.name: Azur's Glintstone Crown
items.description:
Crown of Azur, primeval current sorcerer, set with a prominent blue-green glintstone.

This crown replaced Azur's brain and skull altogether, and now, removed from his body, it is all but dead. What power remains within raises the potency of Azur's primeval current sorceries at the cost of additional FP consumption.

items.name: Azur's Glintstone Robe
items.description:
A robe reserved for grand masters at the Academy of Raya Lucaria.
Corroded by blue-green glintstones.

Since the grand masters Azur and Lusat were driven from the academy, no one has achieved their formerly-held rank.

items.name: Azur's Manchettes
items.description:
Manchettes corroded by blue-green glintstones.
Worn by Azur, primeval current sorcerer.

Azur had reached a near-inorganic state.

items.name: Bandit Boots
items.description:
Leather boots worn by bandits.

Light for ease of movement, and supple for masking sound. In trade, they offer little damage negation.

items.name: Bandit Garb
items.description:
Leather garb worn by bandits.

Light for ease of movement, and supple for masking sound. In trade, they offer little damage negation.

items.name: Bandit Manchettes
items.description:
Manchettes made by simply wrapping dirty cloth around the arms.
Worn by bandits.

items.name: Bandit Mask
items.description:
Mask of black cloth that covers the mouth.

Favored by bandits for hiding their faces, it also provides some protection against poison.

items.name: Banished Knight Armor
items.description:
Thick, full set of armor covering the entire body.
This armor was worn by knights who, whether by misfortune or misdeed, were forced to abandon their homes.

These fierce warriors were each and all accomplished. Perhaps that is why, despite their territorial losses, they were still named knights.

items.name: Banished Knight Helm
items.description:
Thick, full set of armor covering the entire body.
This helm was worn by knights who, whether by misfortune or misdeed, were forced to abandon their homes.

Perhaps the deep-red scarf was used to block the winds, for on the outskirts, the winds bite with a stinging fierceness.

items.description:

This helm was worn by knights who, whether by misfortune or misdeed, were forced to abandon their homes.

items.name: Battlemage Legwraps
items.description: Legwraps worn by scholars of the Raya Lucaria Academy, tattered from being worn on the battlefield.

items.name: Battlemage Manchettes
items.description: Manchettes worn by scholars of the Raya Lucaria Academy, tattered from being worn on the battlefield.

items.name: Battlemage Robe
items.description:
Robe worn by scholars of the Raya Lucaria Academy, tattered from being worn on the battlefield.

Whenever war broke out and the academy sealed its gates, only Haima's scholars dared venture outside.
Seclusion is no way to foster discovery; it is only a convenient form of escape.

items.name: Beast Champion Armor
items.description:
Silver armor engraved with tiny beasts.
Worn by Bernahl the Recusant.

Beasts are drawn to champions, and to lords. And this armor befits a champion worthy of becoming a lord. And that is what Bernahl was.

Until his maiden threw herself into the fire.

items.description:

Worn by Bernahl the Recusant.

Beasts are drawn to champions, and to lords. And this armor befits a champion worthy of becoming a lord. And that is what Bernahl was.

items.description:

Worn by Bernahl the Recusant.

items.name: Beast Champion Greaves
items.description:

Worn by Bernahl the Recusant.

Beasts are drawn to champions, and to lords. And this armor befits a champion worthy of becoming a lord. And that is what Bernahl was.

Until his maiden threw herself into the fire.

items.name: Beast Champion Helm
items.description:
Silver helm engraved with tiny beasts.
Worn by Bernahl the Recusant.

The beasts, their eyes and ears covered, represent an oath: "See nothing, hear nothing, doubt nothing, and carry on, along the path set in stone."

items.name: Black Dumpling
items.description:
Mask forced on a victim's head to lend torture an extra degree of cruelty.
It magnifies one's fears and makes them acutely aware of all forms of pain.

Raises attack power when the wearer suffers from madness.

When the Black Dumpling goes on, the torturer no longer seeks answers; only to inflict suffering without hope of relief.

items.name: Black Hood
items.description:
Hood of lusterless black fabric that conceals its wearer's identity.

In this world, there is very little that must necessarily be known.

items.name: Black Knife Armor
items.description:
Scale armor used by the Black Knife Assassins, forged to make no sound.

Traces of power yet remain in its concealing veil, which muffles the sound of footsteps.

The assassins that carried out the deeds of the Night of the Black Knives were all women, and rumored to be Numen who had close ties with Marika herself.

items.name: Black Knife Armor (Altered)
items.description:
Armor used by the Black Knife Assassins.
Crafted with scale armor that makes no sound.

The assassins that carried out the deeds of the Night of the Black Knives were all women, and rumored to be Numen who had close ties with Marika herself.

items.name: Black Knife Gauntlets
items.description:
Gauntlets used by the Black Knife Assassins.
Crafted with scale armor that makes no sound.

The assassins that carried out the deeds of the Night of the Black Knives were all women, and rumored to be Numen who had close ties with Marika herself.

items.name: Black Knife Greaves
items.description:
Greaves used by the Black Knife Assassins.
Crafted with scale armor that makes no sound.

The assassins that carried out the deeds of the Night of the Black Knives were all women, and rumored to be Numen who had close ties with Marika herself.

items.name: Black Knife Hood
items.description:
Hood used by the Black Knife Assassins.

The assassins that carried out the deeds of the Night of the Black Knives were all women, and rumored to be Numen who had close ties with Marika herself.

items.name: Black Knight Armor
items.description:
Armor worn by the Black Knights, servants of Messmer the Impaler.

Though the engraving above the heart is a Scadutree design, it is etched in gold. A small consolation to those forced to wage a war without grace or honor.

items.name: Black Knight Gauntlets
items.description:
Gauntlets worn by the Black Knights, servants of Messmer the Impaler. Black iron ornamented with gold. A rotten odor stubbornly clings to it.

Perhaps it arises from the tainted nature of the blood that splattered upon it. Or perhaps it is the wearer's own blackened soul, festering after endless slaughter.

items.name: Black Knight Greaves
items.description:
Greaves worn by the Black Knights, servants of Messmer the Impaler. Black iron ornamented with gold. A rotten odor stubbornly clings to it.

Perhaps it arises from the tainted nature of the blood that splattered upon it. Or perhaps it is the wearer's own blackened soul, festering after endless slaughter.

items.name: Black Knight Helm
items.description:
Helm worn by the Black Knights, servants of Messmer the Impaler. Black iron ornamented with gold. A rotten odor stubbornly clings to it.

Perhaps it arises from the tainted nature of the blood that splattered upon it. Or perhaps it is the wearer's own blackened soul, festering after endless slaughter.

items.name: Black Wolf Mask
items.description:
A mask fashioned after the head of a black wolf.

Relic of an assassin who assumed the guise of Ranni the Witch's loyal shadow. The likeness is striking.

items.name: Blackflame Monk Armor
items.description:
Black iron armor adorned with ashen cloth.
Attire of the Blackflame Monks.

The Blackflame Monks, enthralled by the god-slaying black flame, became traitors, abandoning their posts as guardians. The seduction of a taboo is never easily spurned.

items.name: Blackflame Monk Gauntlets
items.description:
Black iron gauntlets featuring a flame motif.
Attire of the Blackflame Monks.

The Blackflame Monks, enthralled by the god-slaying black flame, became traitors, abandoning their posts as guardians. The seduction of a taboo is never easily spurned.

items.name: Blackflame Monk Greaves
items.description:
Black iron greaves featuring a flame motif.
Attire of the Blackflame Monks.

The Blackflame Monks, enthralled by the god-slaying black flame, became traitors, abandoning their posts as guardians. The seduction of a taboo is never easily spurned.

items.name: Blackflame Monk Hood
items.description:
Mail hood of iron links covering a headband
engraved with flames. Attire of the Blackflame Monks.

The Blackflame Monks, enthralled by the god-slaying black flame, became traitors, abandoning their posts as guardians. The seduction of a taboo is never easily spurned.

items.name: Blackguard's Iron Mask
items.description:
Iron mask forced on convicted prisoners.
Worn by the blackguard Big Boggart.

To Boggart, the mask made him all the more threatening, and helped him get what he wanted. But it was also a mirror of his emptiness.

items.name: Blaidd's Armor
items.description:
Well-worn black armor of the man-wolf Blaidd.

The pelt serves as a cape, protecting from cold.
Blaidd was the blade of Ranni, but the cold bothered him anyway.

items.name: Blaidd's Armor (Altered)
items.description:
Well-worn black armor of the man-wolf Blaidd.

Blaidd, who served as Ranni's shadow, was a loyal ally who would defy destiny itself if it would have him turn upon his Lady.

items.name: Blaidd's Gauntlets
items.description:
Well-worn black gauntlets of the man-wolf Blaidd.

Blaidd, who served as Ranni's shadow, was a loyal ally who would defy destiny itself if it would have him turn upon his Lady.

items.name: Blaidd's Greaves
items.description:
Well-worn black greaves of the man-wolf Blaidd.

Blaidd, who served as Ranni's shadow, was a loyal ally who would defy destiny itself if it would have him turn upon his Lady.

items.name: Bloodhound Knight Armor
items.description:
Metal armor with a jutting breastplate.
Worn by the Bloodhound Knights.

The Bloodhound Knights are trained as hunters and known to be unshakable trackers.

Without the use of language, each knight chooses his own master.
Once the decision has been made, the knight stays loyal for life.

items.name: Bloodhound Knight Armor (Altered)
items.description:

Worn by the Bloodhound Knights.

Without the use of language, each knight chooses his own master.

Once the decision has been made, the knight stays loyal for life.

items.name: Bloodhound Knight Helm
items.description:
Metal helm with a pointed beak.
Worn by the Bloodhound Knights.

The Bloodhound Knights are trained as hunters and known to be unshakable trackers.

Without the use of language, each knight chooses his own master.
Once the decision has been made, the knight stays loyal for life.

items.name: Bloodsoaked Manchettes
items.description:
Manchettes formed from tightly-wound bandages soaked through with blood.

Any protection is welcome for the festering arms beneath.

items.name: Bloodsoaked Mask
items.description:
Mask formed from tightly-wound bandages soaked through with blood.

Even the most ghastly cover is more inviting than the festering face beneath.

items.name: Bloodsoaked Tabard
items.description:
Padded cloth armor with indelible bloodstains around the neck.

Worn by headless foot soldiers who endlessly guard the Wandering Mausoleum.

items.name: Blue Cloth Cowl
items.description:
Cowl of a nomadic warrior.
The blue color of its fabric symbolizes brisk waters, as fluid and flowing as the sword in the hand of its wearer.

Just as still waters turn foul, stagnation leads to decay.
Warriors must remain ever drifting.

items.name: Blue Cloth Vest
items.description:
Vest of a nomadic warrior.
The blue color of its fabric symbolizes brisk waters, as fluid and flowing as the sword in the hand of its wearer.

Just as still waters turn foul, stagnation leads to decay.
Warriors must remain ever drifting.

items.name: Blue Festive Garb
items.description:
Ceremonial garb worn by dancers at the festivities in Dominula, the village of windmills.

Use of this garb, dyed in a stunning blue, is only permitted for the young maids who play the central role in the festival.

items.name: Blue Festive Hood
items.description:
Hood worn by dancers at the festivities in Dominula, the village of windmills.

Use of this hood, dyed in a stunning blue, is only permitted for the young maids who play the central role in the festival.

items.name: Blue Silver Bracelets
items.description:
Bracelets crafted with blue silver.
Worn by the wolf-riding Albinauric archers.

Blue silver is a metal born from the same mother as the archers themselves, and provides protection from magic and frost.

items.name: Blue Silver Mail Armor
items.description:
Chainmail armor crafted with blue silver.
Worn by the wolf-riding Albinauric archers.

Blue silver is a metal born from the same mother as the archers themselves, and provides protection from magic and frost.

items.name: Blue Silver Mail Armor (Altered)
items.description:
Chainmail armor crafted with blue silver.
Worn by the wolf-riding Albinauric archers.

Blue silver is a metal born from the same mother as the archers themselves, and provides protection from magic and frost.

items.name: Blue Silver Mail Hood
items.description:
Chainmail hood crafted with blue silver.
Worn by the wolf-riding Albinauric archers.

Blue silver is a metal born from the same mother as the archers themselves, and provides protection from magic and frost.

items.name: Blue Silver Mail Skirt
items.description:
Chainmail skirt crafted with blue silver.
Worn by the wolf-riding Albinauric archers.

Blue silver is a metal born from the same mother as the archers themselves, and provides protection from magic and frost.

items.name: Body
items.description: Bare torso with no armor equipped.

items.name: Braided Arm Wraps
items.description: Ragged black cloth tied with braided cord. Attire of a vengeance-seeking hornsent.

items.name: Braided Cord Robe
items.description:
Ragged black cloth overlaid with braided cord. Attire of a vengeance-seeking hornsent.

The braided cord ties together the vow of the revenger with the victims' grudges. It must never come undone.

Enhances both watchful spirits and the vengeful spirits summoned by horned bairns.

items.name: Briar Armor
items.description:
Battered iron armor from a foreign land.
Worn by Elemer of the Briar.

The winding, rusted iron briars are a mark of the guilty, and typically indicate a sentence of death. They also cause this armor to deal damage when performing dodge rolls.

Elemer murdered numerous instructors and merchants, and was known as the Bell Bearing Hunter.

items.description:

items.name: Bull-Goat Armor
items.description:
Great Horned Tragoth's armor. Covers its wearer with a pair of giant horns, providing staunch poise.

Tragoth is a famed knight of assistance. Countless Tarnished, facing adversity in the Lands Between, have survived thanks only to the Great Horned One's aid.

items.name: Bull-Goat Gauntlets
items.description:
Great Horned Tragoth's gauntlets, adorned with a gold bull-goat motif. Provide high poise.

Tragoth is a famed knight of assistance. Countless Tarnished, facing adversity in the Lands Between, have survived thanks only to the Great Horned One's aid.

items.name: Bull-Goat Greaves
items.description:
Great Horned Tragoth's greaves, adorned with a gold bull-goat motif. Provide high poise.

Tragoth is a famed knight of assistance. Countless Tarnished, facing adversity in the Lands Between, have survived thanks only to the Great Horned One's aid.

items.name: Bull-Goat Helm
items.description:
Great Horned Tragoth's helm, adorned with a gold bull-goat motif. Provides high poise.

Tragoth is a famed knight of assistance. Countless Tarnished, facing adversity in the Lands Between, have survived thanks only to the Great Horned One's aid.

items.name: Carian Knight Armor
items.description:
Armor of the enchanted knights that once served the Carian royal family.

The enchanted knights, anointed by the Lunar Queen, were all heroes of the highest honors, but fell into disarray with the decline of the royal family.

items.name: Carian Knight Armor (Altered)
items.description:
Armor of the enchanted knights that once served the Carian royal family.

The enchanted knights, anointed by the Lunar Queen, were all heroes of the highest honors, but fell into disarray with the decline of the royal family.

items.name: Carian Knight Gauntlets
items.description:
Gauntlets of the enchanted knights that once served the Carian royal family.

The enchanted knights, anointed by the Lunar Queen, were all heroes of the highest honors, but fell into disarray with the decline of the royal family.

items.name: Carian Knight Greaves
items.description:
Greaves of the enchanted knights that once served the Carian royal family.

The enchanted knights, anointed by the Lunar Queen, were all heroes of the highest honors, but fell into disarray with the decline of the royal family.

items.name: Carian Knight Helm
items.description:
Helm of the enchanted knights that once served the Carian royal family.

The enchanted knights, anointed by the Lunar Queen, were all heroes of the highest honors, but fell into disarray with the decline of the royal family.

items.name: Caterpillar Mask
items.description:
Grotesque mask constructed from countless solidified caterpillars. A ritual implement of the greater potentates of Bonny Village.

Used to ward off thoughts of impurity, doubt, temptation, and other wickednesses one is vulnerable to while absorbed in divine ritual.

items.name: Cerulean Tear Scarab
items.description:
Blue scarab worn directly on the head.
These scarabs roll clumps of cerulean tears during their labors.

Slightly increases the recovery effects of the Flask of Cerulean Tears, but increases damage taken.

items.name: Chain Armor
items.description:
Armor made of woven chain.
Standard issue for ordinary soldiers.

Though plain in appearance, it offers dependable protection.

items.name: Chain Coif
items.description:
Coif made of woven chain.
Standard issue for ordinary soldiers.

Though plain in appearance, it offers dependable protection.

items.name: Chain Leggings
items.description:
Leggings made of woven chain.
Standard issue for ordinary soldiers.

Though plain in appearance, they offer dependable protection.

items.name: Chain-Draped Tabard
items.description:
Padded cloth armor with a chainmail shawl draped over the shoulders.

Widely issued to foot soldiers in a lord's army.

items.name: Champion Bracers
items.description:
Bracers reserved for the badlands' bravest.
Proof that the wearer has slaughtered countless foes.

Following the example of their chieftain Hoarah Loux, the brave warriors of the badlands shun excess adornment.

items.name: Champion Gaiters
items.description:
Gaiters formed only with leather straps.
Common wear in the badlands.

items.name: Champion Headband
items.description:
Headband reserved for the badlands' bravest.
Proof that the wearer has slaughtered countless foes.

Following the example of their chieftain Hoarah Loux, the brave warriors of the badlands shun excess adornment.

items.name: Champion Pauldron
items.description:
Pauldron reserved for the badlands' bravest.
Proof that the wearer has slaughtered countless foes.

Following the example of their chieftain Hoarah Loux, the brave warriors of the badlands shun excess adornment.

items.name: Circlet of Light
items.description:
The circlet of light which adorned Miquella's head as he returned in divine aspect. It has begun to fade into nothingness.

Slightly boosts intelligence, faith, and arcane, while also boosting the power of Miquella's light.

This circle was to be the very foundation upon which Miquella's age of compassion would be built, should it have ever come to pass.

items.name: Cleanrot Armor
items.description:
Armor of the Cleanrot Knights, celebrated for their undefeated campaign in the Shattering.

The Cleanrot Knights vowed to fight alongside Malenia, despite the inevitable, if gradual, putrefaction of their flesh. Their acceptance of their fate made these battles the fiercest of all.

items.name: Cleanrot Armor (Altered)
items.description:
Armor of the Cleanrot Knights, celebrated for their undefeated campaign in the Shattering.

The Cleanrot Knights vowed to fight alongside Malenia, despite the inevitable, if gradual, putrefaction of their flesh. Their acceptance of their fate made these battles the fiercest of all.

items.name: Cleanrot Gauntlets
items.description:
Gauntlets of the Cleanrot Knights, celebrated for their undefeated campaign in the Shattering.

The Cleanrot Knights vowed to fight alongside Malenia, despite the inevitable, if gradual, putrefaction of their flesh. Their acceptance of their fate made these battles the fiercest of all.

items.name: Cleanrot Greaves
items.description:
Greaves of the Cleanrot Knights, celebrated for their undefeated campaign in the Shattering.

The Cleanrot Knights vowed to fight alongside Malenia, despite the inevitable, if gradual, putrefaction of their flesh. Their acceptance of their fate made these battles the fiercest of all.

items.name: Cleanrot Helm
items.description:
Winged helm of the Cleanrot Knights, celebrated for their undefeated campaign in the Shattering.

The Cleanrot Knights vowed to fight alongside Malenia, despite the inevitable, if gradual, putrefaction of their flesh. Their acceptance of their fate made these battles the fiercest of all.

items.name: Cleanrot Helm (Altered)
items.description:
Winged helm of the Cleanrot Knights, celebrated for their undefeated campaign in the Shattering.

The Cleanrot Knights vowed to fight alongside Malenia, despite the inevitable, if gradual, putrefaction of their flesh. Their acceptance of their fate made these battles the fiercest of all.

items.name: Cloth Garb
items.description: Clothing made of coarse material, commonly worn in the Lands Between.

items.name: Cloth Trousers
items.description: Trousers made of coarse material, commonly worn in the Lands Between.

items.name: Common Soldier Cloth Armor
items.description:
Cloth armor of the rank-and-file soldiers of Messmer's army.

A pitch-dark soot clings to it, much like the inner faces of the men who wore them.

items.name: Common Soldier Gauntlets
items.description:
Gauntlets of the rank-and-file soldiers of Messmer's army.

A pitch-dark soot clings to it, much like the inner faces of the men who wore them.

items.name: Common Soldier Greaves
items.description:
Greaves of the rank-and-file soldiers of Messmer's army.

A pitch-dark soot clings to it, much like the inner faces of the men who wore them.

items.name: Common Soldier Helm
items.description:
Helm of the rank-and-file soldiers of Messmer's army.

A pitch-dark soot clings to it, much like the inner faces of the men who wore them.

items.name: Commoner's Garb
items.description:
Garb with a thick embroidered cape attached.
Standard wear for commoners of the Lands Between.

The board hung from the neck depicts a sprawling tree, its roots and branches forming two holes. This is a self-imposed shackle, a voluntary display of allegiance to the Erdtree that increases faith.

items.name: Commoner's Garb (Altered)
items.description:
Garb decorated with intricate embroidery.
Standard wear for commoners of the Lands Between.

The board hung from the neck depicts a sprawling tree, its roots and branches forming two holes. This is a self-imposed shackle, a voluntary display of allegiance to the Erdtree that increases faith.

items.name: Commoner's Headband
items.description:
A headband that holds cloth in place.
Standard wear for commoners of the Lands Between.

Only, there are no commoners remaining with their wits about them.

items.name: Commoner's Headband (Altered)
items.description:
A headband with the cloth removed.
Standard wear for commoners of the Lands Between.

Only, there are no commoners remaining with their wits about them.

items.name: Commoner's Shoes
items.description:
Modest shoes made of cloth.
Standard wear for commoners of the Lands Between.

Only, there are no commoners remaining with their wits about them.

items.name: Commoner's Simple Garb
items.description:
Garb with a modest cloth cape attached.
Standard wear for commoners of the Lands Between.

The board hung from the neck depicts a sprawling tree, its roots and branches forming two holes. This is a self-imposed shackle, a voluntary display of allegiance to the Erdtree that increases faith.

items.name: Commoner's Simple Garb (Altered)
items.description:
Modest garb made of cloth.
Standard wear for commoners of the Lands Between.

The board hung from the neck depicts a sprawling tree, its roots and branches forming two holes. This is a self-imposed shackle, a voluntary display of allegiance to the Erdtree that increases faith.

items.name: Confessor Armor
items.description:
Black leather armor for blending in with the darkness.
Worn by church confessors.

The churches outside the Lands Between, dedicated to the teachings of the Two Fingers, send confessors out to follow the guidance of grace.

The confessors are loyal servants to the Two Fingers, ready to hunt down and quietly dispose of their enemies.

items.name: Confessor Armor (Altered)
items.description:
Black leather armor for blending in with the darkness.
Worn by church confessors.

The churches outside the Lands Between, dedicated to the teachings of the Two Fingers, send confessors out to follow the guidance of grace.

The confessors are loyal servants to the Two Fingers, ready to hunt down and quietly dispose of their enemies.

items.name: Confessor Boots
items.description:
Leather boots of the church confessors.

The churches outside the Lands Between, dedicated to the teachings of the Two Fingers, send confessors out to follow the guidance of grace.

The confessors are loyal servants to the Two Fingers, ready to hunt down and quietly dispose of their enemies.

items.name: Confessor Gloves
items.description:
Black leather gloves of the church confessors.

The churches outside the Lands Between, dedicated to the teachings of the Two Fingers, send confessors out to follow the guidance of grace.

The confessors are loyal servants to the Two Fingers, ready to hunt down and quietly dispose of their enemies.

items.name: Confessor Hood
items.description:
Black hood for blending in with the darkness.
Worn by church confessors.

The churches outside the Lands Between, dedicated to the teachings of the Two Fingers, send confessors out to follow the guidance of grace.

The confessors are loyal servants to the Two Fingers, ready to hunt down and quietly dispose of their enemies.

items.name: Confessor Hood (Altered)
items.description:
Cloth headwrap worn under a church confessor's black hood.
Such hoods are made for blending in with the darkness.

items.name: Consort's Mask
items.description:
Mask worn by Tanith, Lady of the Volcano Manor, in the image of a foreign queen.
Increases dexterity.

Long ago, when Rykard first set eyes on Tanith, she was working as a dancer in a foreign land. Soon, he made her his consort.
She was the only human to remain by his side when he became the serpent of blasphemy.

In that moment, Tanith was truly charmed by him.

items.name: Consort's Robe
items.description:
Fine robe of white silk worn by Tanith, Lady of the Volcano Manor.

Long ago, when Rykard first set eyes on Tanith, she was working as a dancer in a foreign land. Soon, he made her his consort.
She was the only human to remain by his side when he became the serpent of blasphemy.

In that moment, Tanith was truly charmed by him.

items.name: Consort's Trousers
items.description: Fine white trousers, perfectly suited for wearing beneath a silk robe.

items.name: Corhyn's Robe
items.description:
Robe of Corhyn the cleric.

Even after exile, Corhyn refused to recant his prophecies. And for this, he was blessed with the guidance of grace.

Since then, the cart wheel draped on his neck has served as a reminder. That true guidance awaits those with iron wills. Those with unwavering faith.

items.name: Crimson Hood
items.description:
A hooded cloak of vivid crimson.
Worn by expatriated royalty.
Increases vigor.

Such cloaks were gifted to those who departed on journeys without specific orders, to faraway lands from which they would never return. In other words, the gift of a cloak made it easier for undesirables to be on their way.

Roderika never once saw the guidance of grace.

items.name: Crimson Tear Scarab
items.description:
Red scarab worn directly on the head.
The red scarabs roll clumps of crimson tears during their labors.

Slightly increases the recovery effects of the Flask of Crimson Tears, but increases damage taken.

items.name: Crucible Axe Armor
items.description:
Armor of the Crucible Knights who served Godfrey, the first Elden Lord.

Worn by the knight Ordovis and his men.

Holds the power of the crucible of life, the primordial form of the Erdtree. Strengthens Aspects of the Crucible incantations.

items.name: Crucible Axe Armor (Altered)
items.description:
Armor of the Crucible Knights who served Godfrey, the first Elden Lord.

Worn by the knight Ordovis and his men.

Holds the power of the crucible of life, the primordial form of the Erdtree. Strengthens Aspects of the Crucible incantations.

items.name: Crucible Axe Helm
items.description:
Helm of the Crucible Knights who served Godfrey, the first Elden Lord.

The axe ornamentation is the knight Ordovis's mark, displayed also by his men.

Holds the power of the crucible of life, the primordial form of the Erdtree. Strengthens Aspects of the Crucible incantations.

items.name: Crucible Gauntlets
items.description:
Gauntlets of the Crucible Knights who served Godfrey, the first Elden Lord.

Hold the power of the crucible of life, the primordial form of the Erdtree. Strengthen Aspects of the Crucible incantations.

In time, the strength shown by these knights, and even their appearance, was seen as chaotic and deserving of scorn.

items.name: Crucible Greaves
items.description:
Greaves of the Crucible Knights who served Godfrey, the first Elden Lord.

Hold the power of the crucible of life, the primordial form of the Erdtree. Strengthen Aspects of the Crucible incantations.

In time, the strength shown by these knights, and even their appearance, was seen as chaotic and deserving of scorn.

items.name: Crucible Hammer-Helm
items.description:
Helm worn by Devonia, longest-serving of the Crucible Knights.

Holds the power of the crucible of life, the primordial form of the Erdtree. Strengthens Aspects of the Crucible incantations.

It is said Devonia quested in search of the Crucible's origin, and departed from the lands of the Erdtree alone.

items.name: Crucible Tree Armor
items.description:
Armor of the Crucible Knights who served Godfrey, the first Elden Lord.

Worn by the knight Siluria and her men.

Holds the power of the crucible of life, the primordial form of the Erdtree. Strengthens Aspects of the Crucible incantations.

items.name: Crucible Tree Armor (Altered)
items.description:
Armor of the Crucible Knights who served Godfrey, the first Elden Lord.

Worn by the knight Siluria and her men.

Holds the power of the crucible of life, the primordial form of the Erdtree. Strengthens Aspects of the Crucible incantations.

items.name: Crucible Tree Helm
items.description:
Helm of the Crucible Knights who served Godfrey, the first Elden Lord.

The great tree ornamentation is the knight Siluria's mark, displayed also by her men.

Holds the power of the crucible of life, the primordial form of the Erdtree. Strengthens Aspects of the Crucible incantations.

items.name: Cuckoo Knight Armor
items.description:
Armor worn by Raya Lucaria Academy knights.

Its left breast is emblazoned with a peering cuckoo, whence came their name.
Perhaps the bird's shrewd gaze is an expression of their refusal to be mere servants of the academy.

items.name: Cuckoo Knight Armor (Altered)
items.description:
Armor worn by Raya Lucaria Academy knights.

Its left breast is emblazoned with a peering cuckoo, whence came their name.
Perhaps the bird's shrewd gaze is an expression of their refusal to be mere servants of the academy.

items.name: Cuckoo Knight Gauntlets
items.description:
Gauntlets worn by Raya Lucaria Academy knights.
Time has yet to dull their luster.

items.name: Cuckoo Knight Greaves
items.description:
Greaves worn by Raya Lucaria Academy knights.
Time has yet to dull their luster.

items.name: Cuckoo Knight Helm
items.description:
Helm worn by Raya Lucaria Academy knights.
Its brow is adorned with a single cuckoo's feather.

items.name: Cuckoo Surcoat
items.description:
Armor worn by Raya Lucaria Academy soldiers.

The surcoat depicts twinned cuckoos peering into a flourishing mass of glintstone.
To a glintstone sorcerer, the body is a transient thing. The Cuckoo alone knows its insignificance, yet watches over it all the same.

items.name: Curseblade Mask
items.description:
A mask affixed with a crown of tangled horns, worn by those who would invoke divinity.

Divine invocation heightens the dexterity of the wearer, but causes the blessing of the Erdtree to become nauseating, reducing the restorative effect of drinking from a flask of sacred tears.

Focus is also troubled by wearing this mask.

items.name: Dancer's Bracer
items.description:
Metal bracer of the Ranah dancers.

Enhances the power of dancing attacks.

Designed to protect the sword-wielding hand.

items.name: Dancer's Dress
items.description:
Bright-red dress of the Ranah dancers.
Enhances the power of dancing attacks.

The dance of Ranah is one of burning passion, and the most passionate dancers never allow their fiery dance to end, losing even their names as they dance on.

To see the passion fade is to see the dancer's flame extinguished.

items.name: Dancer's Dress (Altered)
items.description:
Altered form of the bright-red dress of the Ranah dancers.
These are the black undergarments worn beneath.

Enhances the power of dancing attacks.

items.name: Dancer's Hood
items.description:
Bright-red hood of the Ranah dancers.
Enhances the power of dancing attacks.

The dance of Ranah is one of burning passion, and the most passionate dancers never allow their fiery dance to end, losing even their names as they dance on.

To see the passion fade is to see the dancer's flame extinguished.

items.name: Dancer's Trousers
items.description:
Long, black trousers worn underneath the bright-red dress of the Ranah dancers.

Enhances the power of dancing attacks.

items.name: Dane's Hat
items.description:
The sun-faded and lightly soiled hat of Dryleaf Dane. Worn low over the eyes, it obscures the wearer's vision.

Meeting the gaze of another can overcome the senses, often leading to the downfall of those who would walk the noble and solitary seekers' path.

items.name: Death Knight Armor
items.description:
Golden armor of the Death Knights, adorned with an antiquated depiction of the Erdtree.

Enhances skills and incantations of the capital's ancient dragon cult.

These knights, once Godwyn's personal guard, quested to find their transfigured master's cadaver surrogate—for the coming age of the Duskborn.

items.name: Death Knight Gauntlets
items.description:
Golden gauntlets of the Death Knights, adorned with an antiquated depiction of the Erdtree.

Enhances skills and incantations of the capital's ancient dragon cult.

These knights, once Godwyn's personal guard, quested to find their transfigured master's cadaver surrogate—for the coming age of the Duskborn.

items.name: Death Knight Greaves
items.description:
Golden greaves of the Death Knights, adorned with an antiquated depiction of the Erdtree.

Enhances skills and incantations of the capital's ancient dragon cult.

These knights, once Godwyn's personal guard, quested to find their transfigured master's cadaver surrogate—for the coming age of the Duskborn.

items.name: Death Knight Helm
items.description:
Golden helm of the Death Knights, whose own death masks served as the visards of their armor.

Enhances skills and incantations of the capital's ancient dragon cult.

The decayed golden wheel that adorns it represents their unbroken loyalty to Godwyn, he who became Prince of Death.

items.name: Death Mask Helm
items.description:
Helm of Wego, elder among the Fire Knights. Two warped death masks stacked one atop the other.

Reduces FP used to summon spirits.

Gnawed at by loneliness, the old man turned his attention to the spirituality of Messmer's flame, using it in a rite of resurrection.

Yet the soulless bodies he brought to life were no comfort to poor Wego.

items.name: Deathbed Dress
items.description:
Extremely thin and sheer white dress worn by the Deathbed Companion as she embraces the dead.

Slowly replenishes the HP of nearby allies, but not that of the wearer.

The touch of the fabric is exceedingly soft, so as not to harm even the most withered corpse, while still sharing her warmth.

items.name: Depraved Perfumer Gloves
items.description:
Gloves worn by depraved perfumers.

These heresy-inclined perfumers imbibe their own spices to alter body and mind. Their slow descent into self-destruction is what earned them their name.

items.name: Depraved Perfumer Headscarf
items.description:
Headscarf worn by depraved perfumers.

These heresy-inclined perfumers imbibe their own spices to alter body and mind. Their slow descent into self-destruction is what earned them their name.

items.name: Depraved Perfumer Robe
items.description:
Robe worn by depraved perfumers.
The embroidery on the apron is itself a curse upon the Erdtree.

These heresy-inclined perfumers imbibe their own spices to alter body and mind. Their slow descent into self-destruction is what earned them their name.

items.name: Depraved Perfumer Robe (Altered)
items.description:
Robe worn by depraved perfumers.
The embroidery on the apron is itself a curse upon the Erdtree.

These heresy-inclined perfumers imbibe their own spices to alter body and mind. Their slow descent into self-destruction is what earned them their name.

items.name: Depraved Perfumer Trousers
items.description:
Trousers worn by depraved perfumers.

These heresy-inclined perfumers imbibe their own spices to alter body and mind. Their slow descent into self-destruction is what earned them their name.

items.name: Diallos's Mask
items.description:
Replica of a twin-tailed silver helm with flowery adornments. Only, without the twin tails.

Diallos Hoslow had an older brother who was a stern, self-possessed man of few words. His achievements made him seem out of reach.

And so the younger aspired to be like the older. Yearning for the day that he would tell the tale of House Hoslow, in blood. Knowing full well that it would break his brother's heart.

items.name: Dirty Chainmail
items.description:
Chainmail worn by young Albinaurics.
The appearance of a protruding belly provides no benefits worthy of note.

items.name: Divine Beast Head
items.description:
Ritual headwear in the form of a divine beast's head, used to perform the lion dance. Worn by the very finest of the sculpted keepers. Alas, it no longer responds to the old woman's earnest prayer.

Divine invocation heightens intensity of the storm alongside strength and dexterity, but reduces the restorative effect of drinking from a flask of sacred tears.

Focus is also troubled by wearing this headwear.

items.name: Divine Beast Helm
items.description:
A helm of tangled horn attached to a divine beast mask, allowing the wearer to invoke divinity. Worn by divine beast warriors; the chosen of the horned warriors.

Divine invocation heightens intensity of the storm alongside strength and dexterity, but reduces the restorative effect of drinking from a flask of sacred tears.

Focus is also troubled by wearing this helm.

items.name: Divine Beast Warrior Armor
items.description:
Armor of feted horned warriors chosen to become divine beast warriors, adorned with a lion's pelt.

Among the divine beast warriors, only those who truly excel at divine invocation become sculpted keepers, and are granted the honor of the lion dance.

items.name: Divine Bird Helm
items.description:
A helm of tangled horn attached to a divine bird mask, allowing the wearer to invoke divinity. Worn by divine bird warriors; the very first of all horned warriors.

Divine invocation heightens the power of divine bird feathers alongside strength and dexterity, but reduces the restorative effect of drinking from a flask of sacred tears.

Focus is also troubled by wearing this helm.

items.name: Divine Bird Warrior Armor
items.description:
Armor of divine bird warriors, the very first of all horned warriors, made from a golden metal.

The golden-hued divine birds are known to be cruel, never taking to human companionship. Those who invoked their divinity were few and far between.

items.name: Divine Bird Warrior Gauntlets
items.description:
Gauntlets of divine bird warriors, the very first of all horned warriors, made from a golden metal.

The golden-hued divine birds are known to be cruel, never taking to human companionship. Those who invoked their divinity were few and far between.

items.name: Divine Bird Warrior Greaves
items.description:
Greaves of divine bird warriors, the very first of all horned warriors, made from a golden metal.

The great, sharp talons increase the force generated by kicks.

items.name: Drake Knight Armor
items.description:
Black iron armor worn by drake knights.
Features the spoils of a dragon catch as an emblem of pride as both dragon hunter and partaker of communion.

The cape is crafted with dragon wing membrane.

items.name: Drake Knight Armor (Altered)
items.description:
Black iron armor worn by drake knights.
Features the spoils of a dragon catch as an emblem of pride as both dragon hunter and partaker of communion.

From birth, drake knights speak not a word. They spend their lives pursuing the strength of dragons, for its sublime beauty and inspiration of awe.

items.name: Drake Knight Gauntlets
items.description:
Black iron gauntlets worn by drake knights.
Features the spoils of a dragon catch as an emblem of pride as both dragon hunter and partaker of communion.

From birth, drake knights speak not a word. They spend their lives pursuing the strength of dragons, for its sublime beauty and inspiration of awe.

items.name: Drake Knight Greaves
items.description:
Black iron greaves by drake knights.
Features the spoils of a dragon catch as an emblem of pride as both dragon hunter and partaker of communion.

From birth, drake knights speak not a word. They spend their lives pursuing the strength of dragons, for its sublime beauty and inspiration of awe.

items.name: Drake Knight Helm
items.description:
Black iron helm worn by drake knights.
Features the spoils of a dragon catch as an emblem of pride as both dragon hunter and partaker of communion.

From birth, drake knights speak not a word. They spend their lives pursuing the strength of dragons, for its sublime beauty and inspiration of awe.

items.name: Drake Knight Helm (Altered)
items.description:
Black iron helm worn by drake knights.
Features the spoils of a dragon catch as an emblem of pride as both dragon hunter and partaker of communion.

From birth, drake knights speak not a word. They spend their lives pursuing the strength of dragons, for its sublime beauty and inspiration of awe.

items.name: Dryleaf Arm Wraps
items.description:
Sun-faded and lightly soiled arm wraps.

Wound tightly around the arms as if it might prevent them from being broken.

items.name: Dryleaf Cuissardes
items.description:
Sun-faded and lightly soiled travel attire worn by clergymen.
Boots made of sturdy leather.

items.name: Dryleaf Robe
items.description:
Sun-faded and lightly soiled travel attire worn by clergymen.

The gold necklace found under the breast belongs to a group of spiritual seekers known as the Dryleaf Sect.

This sect rejects dependence on others in all matters of faith, seeking self-discipline and self-sufficiency above all else.

items.name: Dryleaf Robe (Altered)
items.description:
Sun-faded and lightly soiled travel attire worn by clergymen.

The leather satchel hanging from the shoulder is decorated with one of Miquella's emblems, a golden grass motif.

items.name: Duelist Greaves
items.description:
Greaves encircled by bronze snakes.
Worn by gladiators who were driven from the colosseum. The wearer becomes a slightly easier target for foes.

The snake is viewed as a traitor to the Erdtree, and the audience delighted in seeing these bronze effigies beaten and battered.

items.name: Duelist Helm
items.description:
Bronze helm decorated with innumerable snakes.
Worn by gladiators who were driven from the colosseum. The wearer becomes a slightly easier target for foes.

The snake is viewed as a traitor to the Erdtree, and the audience delighted in seeing these bronze effigies beaten and battered.

items.name: Eccentric's Armor
items.description:
Unusually colorful armor.
Worn by the knight Jerren.

Jerren preferred a nomadic existence, but after spending time as a guest of the Carian royals, he became a guest commander for General Radahn.

And for the first time, the restless tumbleweed would be bound by honorable oath.

items.name: Eccentric's Breeches
items.description:
The knight Jerren's breeches.

Jerren preferred a nomadic existence, but after spending time as a guest of the Carian royals, he became the guest commander for General Radahn.

And for the first time, the restless tumbleweed would be bound by honorable oath.

items.name: Eccentric's Hood
items.description:
A pointy, ragged hood.
Worn by the knight Jerren.

The hood hides an aged, bearded mask.

Jerren served General Radahn as a guest commander, and they are said to have sworn an oath of honorable death to one another.

items.name: Eccentric's Hood (Altered)
items.description:
A pointy, ragged hood.
Worn by the knight Jerren.

The hood hides an aged, bearded mask.

Jerren served General Radahn as a guest commander, and they are said to have sworn an oath of honorable death to one another.

items.name: Eccentric's Manchettes
items.description:
The knight Jerren's manchettes.

Jerren preferred a nomadic existence, but after spending time as a guest of the Carian royals, he became the guest commander for General Radahn.

And for the first time, the restless tumbleweed would be bound by honorable oath.

items.name: Elden Lord Armor
items.description:
Armor of Godfrey, the first Elden Lord.

The age of the Erdtree began amongst conflict, when Godfrey was lord of the battlefield.

He led the War against the Giants. Faced the Storm Lord, alone. And then, there came a moment. When his last worthy enemy fell. And it was then, as the story is told, that the hue of Lord Godfrey's eyes faded.

items.name: Elden Lord Armor (Altered)
items.description:

He led the War against the Giants. Faced the Storm Lord, alone. And then, there came a moment. When his last worthy enemy fell. And it was then, as the story is told, that the hue of Lord Godfrey's eyes faded.

items.description:

items.description:

items.name: Envoy Crown
items.description:
The soft bundle worn on the head by Oracle Envoys.
Densely wrapped in several layers of cloth.

Raises the potency of bubble-based skills.

No one knows what the cloth hides, but some claim to have heard a faint whimpering from inside. It must have been their imagination.

items.name: Erdtree Surcoat
items.description:
Armor worn by soldiers sworn to defend the royal capital of Leyndell.

The surcoat bears a majestic likeness of the Erdtree. Its golden backing is an honor bestowed on no other soldiers.

items.name: Errant Sorcerer Boots
items.description: Commonplace leather boots, sturdy enough to withstand a long journey.

items.name: Errant Sorcerer Manchettes
items.description:
Commonplace leather manchettes.
Their hands are inlaid with dulled glintstone.

items.name: Errant Sorcerer Robe
items.description:
Commonplace robe made of thick cloth.
Worn by the Errant Sorcerer Wilhelm, one of the first Tarnished to visit Roundtable Hold.

A silent seeker of sorcery, who had gone so far as to make contact with the primeval current, Wilhelm was led by guidance into confrontation with his friend Vargram, and it is said that he was then taken prisoner in Roundtable Hold.

items.name: Errant Sorcerer Robe (Altered)
items.description:
Commonplace robe made of thick cloth.
Worn by the Errant Sorcerer Wilhelm, one of the first Tarnished to visit Roundtable Hold.

A silent seeker of sorcery, who had gone so far as to make contact with the primeval current, Wilhelm was led by guidance into confrontation with his friend Vargram, and it is said that he was then taken prisoner in Roundtable Hold.

items.name: Exile Armor
items.description:
Damaged armor draped with a large deep-red cloth.
Worn by soldiers sent to the penal colonies.

items.name: Exile Gauntlets
items.description:
Damaged iron gauntlets.
Worn by soldiers sent to the penal colonies.

items.name: Exile Greaves
items.description:
Damaged iron greaves.
Worn by soldiers sent to the penal colonies.

items.name: Exile Hood
items.description:
Deep red hood that covers the whole head.

Worn by soldiers sent to the penal colonies, who were required to keep their faces hidden.

items.name: Eye Surcoat
items.description:
Brown surcoat draped over chainmail.

The insignia emblazoned on the front marks out the wearer as the eyes and ears of Sir Gideon the All-Knowing.

items.name: Fang Helm
items.description:
Helm of Red Bear, whose name is lost to madness.
The cheek guards are shaped after lion fangs.

Perhaps his fascination with the untamed strength of the wild stemmed from his past as a Redmane.

items.name: Fell Omen Cloak
items.description:
A cloak of ragged fur worn about the exposed body of Margit, the Fell Omen.

Having slaughtered countless champions during the Shattering, the Fell Omen has become a horror to those who harbor ambitions for the Erdtree, or for Lordship.

items.name: Festive Garb
items.description:
Ceremonial garb worn by dancers at the festivities in Dominula, the village of windmills.

Faintly bloodstained.

items.name: Festive Garb (Altered)
items.description:
Ceremonial garb worn by dancers at the festivities in Dominula, the village of windmills.

Faintly bloodstained.

items.name: Festive Hood
items.description:
Hood worn by dancers at the festivities in Dominula, the village of windmills.

Decorated with many-colored flowers.

items.name: Festive Hood (Altered)
items.description:
Hood worn by dancers at the festivities in Dominula, the village of windmills.

Decorated with a stunning array of flowers.

items.name: Fia's Hood
items.description:
Hood of black cloth that covers the whole head.
Worn by Fia, the Deathbed Companion, on her journey after being exiled from her home.

The fabric itself is soft as silk.

items.name: Fia's Robe
items.description:
Robe of black cloth that covers the entire body.
Worn by Fia, the Deathbed Companion, on her journey after being exiled from her home.

The fabric itself is soft as silk and thin enough that those embraced can feel every pulse; every bit of her warmth.

items.name: Fia's Robe (Altered)
items.description:
Robe of black cloth that covers the entire body.
Worn by Fia, the Deathbed Companion, on her journey after being exiled from her home.

The fabric itself is soft as silk and thin enough that those embraced can feel every pulse; every bit of her warmth.

items.name: Finger Maiden Fillet
items.description:
Fillet worn by maidens who serve the Two Fingers.

The maidens live to serve a chosen Tarnished, sharing their guidance and the wisdom of the Two Fingers.

The guidance of grace would ensure that the pair be brought together. Or at least, such was the promise long ago.

items.name: Finger Maiden Robe
items.description:
Robe worn by maidens who serve the Two Fingers.

The maidens live to serve a chosen Tarnished, sharing their guidance and the wisdom of the Two Fingers.

The guidance of grace would ensure that the pair be brought together. Or at least, such was the promise long ago.

items.name: Finger Maiden Robe (Altered)
items.description:
Robe worn by maidens who serve the Two Fingers.

The maidens live to serve a chosen Tarnished, sharing their guidance and the wisdom of the Two Fingers.

The guidance of grace would ensure that the pair be brought together. Or at least, such was the promise long ago.

items.name: Finger Maiden Shoes
items.description:
Shoes worn by maidens who serve the Two Fingers.

The maidens live to serve a chosen Tarnished, sharing their guidance and the wisdom of the Two Fingers.

The guidance of grace would ensure that the pair be brought together. Or at least, such was the promise long ago.

items.name: Finger Robe
items.description:
Robe of Count Ymir, High Priest.
The front is open, exposing the squirming fingers beneath.

This robe is the image of his fervent desire having broken free, laying bare his greatest wish, and wearing it enhances finger sorceries.

"I will be the true mother.
My fingers will grant us redemption!"

items.name: Fingerprint Armor
items.description:
Iron armor singed and blistered by fingers.
Worn by Vyke, knight of the Roundtable Hold.

No other Tarnished was closer to the throne of the Elden Lord than Vyke. But without announcement, Vyke traveled far below the capital, and was scorched by the flame of frenzy.

Did he make his choice for his maiden, or did some other force lure him with suggestion?

items.name: Fingerprint Armor (Altered)
items.description:
Iron armor singed and blistered by fingers.
Worn by Vyke, knight of the Roundtable Hold.

No other Tarnished was closer to the throne of the Elden Lord than Vyke. But without announcement, Vyke traveled far below the capital, and was scorched by the flame of frenzy.

Did he make his choice for his maiden, or did some other force lure him with suggestion?

items.description:
