Did he make his choice for his maiden, or did some other force lure him with suggestion?

items.name: Fingerprint Greaves
items.description:
Iron greaves singed and blistered by fingers.
Worn by Vyke, knight of the Roundtable Hold.

No other Tarnished was closer to the throne of the Elden Lord than Vyke. But without announcement, Vyke traveled far below the capital, and was scorched by the flame of frenzy.

Did he make his choice for his maiden, or did some other force lure him with suggestion?

items.name: Fingerprint Helm
items.description:
Iron helm singed and blistered by fingers.
Worn by Vyke, knight of the Roundtable Hold.

No other Tarnished was closer to the throne of the Elden Lord than Vyke. But without announcement, Vyke traveled far below the capital, and was scorched by the flame of frenzy.

Did he make his choice for his maiden, or did some other force lure him with suggestion?

items.name: Fire Knight Armor
items.description:
Armor of the Fire Knights under Messmer the Impaler's personal command.

Distinguished by its red cape and twin golden snakes which adorn the neck, enhancing incantations of Messmer's flame.

These were the only ones who truly knew Messmer. His flames, like serpents. The painful fate that accompanied his accursed form.

items.name: Fire Knight Armor (Altered)
items.description:
Armor of the Fire Knights under Messmer the Impaler's personal command.

Each and every knight hailed from a renowned family of the Erdtree's upper echelons, but were shunned and chased from their homes after pledging allegiance to Messmer as their master.

items.name: Fire Knight Gauntlets
items.description:
Gauntlets of the Fire Knights under Messmer the Impaler's personal command.

Each and every knight hailed from a renowned family of the Erdtree's upper echelons, but were shunned and chased from their homes after pledging allegiance to Messmer as their master.

items.name: Fire Knight Greaves
items.description:
Greaves of the Fire Knights under Messmer the Impaler's personal command.

Each and every knight hailed from a renowned family of the Erdtree's upper echelons, but were shunned and chased from their homes after pledging allegiance to Messmer as their master.

items.name: Fire Knight Helm
items.description:
Pointed helm of the Fire Knights under Messmer the Impaler's personal command.

Slightly increases maximum HP, stamina, and maximum equip load.

Each and every knight hailed from a renowned family of the Erdtree's upper echelons, but were shunned and chased from their homes after pledging allegiance to Messmer as their master.

items.name: Fire Monk Armor
items.description:
Black iron armor adorned with a red cloth.
Attire of the Fire Monks.

The grotesque face sculpted on the chest is said to depict the corrupt ancient god of the flame.
Taboos transform into lasting obsessions by virtue of the fear that they inspire.

items.name: Fire Monk Gauntlets
items.description:
Black iron gauntlets featuring a flame motif.
Attire of the Fire Monks.

The Fire Monks are guardians of the flame of ruin, forbidden by the Erdtree and said to be kept high in the Mountaintops of the Giants.

items.name: Fire Monk Greaves
items.description:
Black iron greaves featuring a flame motif.
Attire of the Fire Monks.

The Fire Monks are guardians of the flame of ruin, forbidden by the Erdtree and said to be kept high in the Mountaintops of the Giants.

items.name: Fire Monk Hood
items.description:
Mail hood of iron links covering a headband
engraved with flames. Attire of the Fire Monks.

The Fire Monks are guardians of the flame of ruin, forbidden by the Erdtree and said to be kept high in the Mountaintops of the Giants.

items.name: Fire Prelate Armor
items.description:
Black iron armor adorned with a red cloth.
Attire of the Fire Prelates, commanders of the Fire Monks.

The weighty frames of the Prelates symbolized the onus of their grave vows as guardians of the flame. "Etch this sight upon thine breast. Of my thunderous gravity."

items.name: Fire Prelate Armor (Altered)
items.description:
Black iron armor.
Attire of the Fire Prelates, commanders of the Fire Monks.

The weighty frames of the Prelates symbolized the onus of their grave vows as guardians of the flame. "Etch this sight upon thine breast. Of my thunderous gravity."

items.name: Fire Prelate Gauntlets
items.description:
Black iron gauntlets with the appearance of flames.
Attire of the Fire Prelates, commanders of the Fire Monks.

The weighty frames of the Prelates symbolized the onus of their grave vows as guardians of the flame. "Etch this sight upon thine breast. Of my thunderous gravity."

items.name: Fire Prelate Greaves
items.description:
Black iron greaves with the appearance of flames.
Attire of the Fire Prelates, commanders of the Fire Monks.

The weighty frames of the Prelates symbolized the onus of their grave vows as guardians of the flame. "Etch this sight upon thine breast. Of my thunderous gravity."

items.name: Fire Prelate Helm
items.description:
Helm engraved with a sacred countenance and housing a cauldron.
Attire of the Fire Prelates, commanders of the Fire Monks.

It is said the cauldron perched atop the head was originally furnished with embers, and would surge into flames when the wearer's faith reached its zenith. The fire of this cauldron has since died out, however.

items.name: Foot Soldier Cap
items.description: Flanged iron cap widely issued to foot soldiers in a lord's army.

items.name: Foot Soldier Gauntlets
items.description:
Metal gauntlets covered in nicks and dents.
Widely issued to foot soldiers in a lord's army.

items.name: Foot Soldier Greaves
items.description:
Metal greaves that have already been mended countless times.
Widely issued to foot soldiers in a lord's army.

items.name: Foot Soldier Helm
items.description:
Wholly unembellished iron helm.
Widely issued to foot soldiers in a lord's army.

items.name: Foot Soldier Helmet
items.description:
Helmet with a protective metal plate.
Widely issued to foot soldiers in a lord's army.

items.name: Foot Soldier Tabard
items.description:
Padded cloth armor with more than a few stains.
Widely issued to foot soldiers in a lord's army.

items.name: Freyja's Armor
items.description:
Golden armor of Redmane Freyja, member of General Radahn's most distinguished knights. Affixed with a black woolen mantle.

After witnessing Freyja's valor as a gladiator in his youth, Radahn invited her to join the ranks of his most trusted warriors.

items.name: Freyja's Armor (Altered)
items.description:
Golden armor of Redmane Freyja, member of General Radahn's most distinguished knights.

After witnessing Freyja's valor as a gladiator in his youth, Radahn invited her to join the ranks of his most trusted warriors.

items.name: Freyja's Gauntlets
items.description:
Golden gauntlets of Redmane Freyja, member of General Radahn's most distinguished knights.

After witnessing Freyja's valor as a gladiator in his youth, Radahn invited her to join the ranks of his most trusted warriors.

items.name: Freyja's Greaves
items.description:
Greaves of Redmane Freyja, member of General Radahn's most distinguished knights.

After witnessing Freyja's valor as a gladiator in his youth, Radahn invited her to join the ranks of his most trusted warriors.

items.name: Freyja's Helm
items.description:
Golden helm of Redmane Freyja, member of General Radahn's most distinguished knights.

A hideous scarlet wound was once hewn into the center of her face.

Later, Miquella gently put his lips to it and the unfading scar became the compass that Freyja would thereafter follow.

items.name: Fur Leggings
items.description:
Leggings fashioned from bristly pelts.
Worn by ancestral follower warriors.

The ancestral followers keep their distance from the Erdtree, awaiting new buds. They are certain to sprout from their very flesh, and indeed, their souls.

items.name: Fur Raiment
items.description:
Raiment fashioned from a bristly pelt.
Worn by ancestral follower warriors.

The ancestral followers keep their distance from the Erdtree, awaiting new buds. They are certain to sprout from their very flesh, and indeed, their souls.

items.name: Gaius's Armor
items.description:
The black iron chest armor of Commander Gaius.
Part of an armor set patterned after fallen seeds.

Gaius was the most senior disciple of the same Alabaster Lord who taught Radahn and Gaea gravitational technique.

items.name: Gaius's Gauntlets
items.description:
The black iron gauntlets of Commander Gaius.
Part of an armor set patterned after fallen seeds.

Gaius was the most senior disciple of the same Alabaster Lord who taught Radahn and Gaea gravitational technique.

items.name: Gaius's Greaves
items.description:
Black iron greaves made for Commander Gaius.
A cruel joke, for he could not wear them.

Riding atop the boar he called his other half, Gaius was in fact a warrior of albinauric extraction.

items.name: Gaius's Helm
items.description:
The black iron helm of Commander Gaius.
Part of an armor set patterned after fallen seeds.

Gaius was the most senior disciple of the same Alabaster Lord who taught Radahn and Gaea gravitational technique.

items.name: Gauntlets
items.description:
Gauntlets worn by ordinary soldiers.

Though plain in appearance, they offer dependable protection.

items.name: Gauntlets of Night
items.description:
Bottomless black gauntlets, cool to the touch.
Flowing lines in the seeming shape of a fingerprint adorn the surface. Imprisons the wearer in utterly lightless dark.

Bestowed upon those born deep underground, ordaining them as Swordhands of Night.

items.name: Gauntlets of Solitude
items.description:
Steel gauntlets of the Knights of the Solitary Gaol.
Part of a heavy armor set that covers the whole body in overlapping plates of steel.

The nameless mausoleums of the realm of shadow are said to hold the spirits of warriors who lost their names, or their hearts.

items.name: Gelmir Knight Armor
items.description:
Armor worn by knights once loyal to Praetor Rykard.

It bears an emblem that none wear any longer, standing as it does for a lord that fell from lofty ambition into gluttonous depravity.
As the lord lost his dignity, so too did these knights lose their master.

items.name: Gelmir Knight Armor (Altered)
items.description:
Armor worn by knights once loyal to Praetor Rykard.

It bears an emblem that none wear any longer, standing as it does for a lord that fell from lofty ambition into gluttonous depravity.
As the lord lost his dignity, so too did these knights lose their master.

items.name: Gelmir Knight Gauntlets
items.description:
Gauntlets worn by knights once loyal to Praetor Rykard.
Time has yet to dull their luster.

items.name: Gelmir Knight Greaves
items.description:
Greaves worn by knights once loyal to Praetor Rykard.
Time has yet to dull their luster.

items.name: Gelmir Knight Helm
items.description:
Helm worn by knights once loyal to Praetor Rykard.
Its crest of red feathers symbolizes Rykard's pedigree as Lord Radagon's son.

items.name: Gilded Foot Soldier Cap
items.description:
Flanged cap made from gilded iron.
Issued to foot soldiers protecting the royal capital of Leyndell.

items.name: Glintstone Scarab
items.description:
Blue-green scarab worn directly on the head.
These scarabs roll clumps of sorcery during their labors.

Slightly reduces the FP costs of sorceries, but increases damage taken.

items.name: Gloried Attire
items.description:
Traditional garb of highland warriors, made from woven fabric and finished with fur. This garment is made from fabrics with both blue and red patterns.

Red-patterned fabrics were allowed only to those who hunted bears—the greatest and most glorious of the highlanders.

items.name: Godrick Knight Armor
items.description:
Armor worn by knights loyal to Godrick the Grafted.

Its left breast is emblazoned with a two-headed war axe, an emblem of the golden lineage.
The knights surely boasted of their strength in days long gone.

items.name: Godrick Knight Armor (Altered)
items.description:
Armor worn by knights loyal to Godrick the Grafted.

Its left breast is emblazoned with a two-headed war axe, an emblem of the golden lineage.
The knights surely boasted of their strength in days long gone.

items.name: Godrick Knight Gauntlets
items.description:
Gauntlets worn by knights loyal to Godrick the Grafted.
Time has yet to dull their luster.

items.name: Godrick Knight Greaves
items.description:
Greaves worn by knights loyal to Godrick the Grafted.
Time has yet to dull their luster.

items.name: Godrick Knight Helm
items.description:
Helm worn by knights loyal to Godrick the Grafted.
Adorned with a plume of withered, ashen hair.

items.name: Godrick Soldier Gauntlets
items.description:
Gauntlets worn by soldiers loyal to Godrick the Grafted.
Rust-worn and stained through unending conflict.

items.name: Godrick Soldier Greaves
items.description:
Greaves worn by soldiers loyal to Godrick the Grafted.
Rust-worn and stained through unending conflict.

items.name: Godrick Soldier Helm
items.description:
Helm worn by soldiers loyal to Godrick the Grafted.
Made from durable iron, layered with a chainmail coif beneath.

items.name: Godskin Apostle Bracelets
items.description:
Black bracelets of the Godskin Apostles.

The apostles, once said to serve Destined Death, are wielders of the god-slaying black flame. But after their defeat by Maliketh, the Black Blade, the source of their power was sealed away.

items.name: Godskin Apostle Hood
items.description:
Hood made by sewing together patches of smooth skin.
Worn by the Godskin Apostles.

The apostles, once said to serve Destined Death, are wielders of the god-slaying black flame. But after their defeat by Maliketh, the Black Blade, the source of their power was sealed away.

items.name: Godskin Apostle Robe
items.description:
Robe made by sewing together patches of smooth skin.
Worn by the Godskin Apostles.

The apostles, once said to serve Destined Death, are wielders of the god-slaying black flame. But after their defeat by Maliketh, the Black Blade, the source of their power was sealed away.

items.name: Godskin Apostle Trousers
items.description:
Trousers made by sewing together patches of smooth skin.
Worn by the Godskin Apostles.

The apostles, once said to serve Destined Death, are wielders of the god-slaying black flame. But after their defeat by Maliketh, the Black Blade, the source of their power was sealed away.

items.name: Godskin Noble Bracelets
items.description:
Black bracelets of the Godskin Nobles.

Nobles are the most ancient apostles who are said to have assimilated inhuman physiology. Not unlike the crucible, the Erdtree in its primordial form.

items.name: Godskin Noble Hood
items.description:
Hood made by sewing together patches of smooth skin.
Subcutaneous fat makes it plump and soft.
Worn by Godskin Nobles.

Nobles are the most ancient apostles who are said to have assimilated inhuman physiology. Not unlike the crucible, the Erdtree in its primordial form.

items.name: Godskin Noble Robe
items.description:
Robe made by sewing together patches of smooth skin.
Subcutaneous fat makes it plump and soft. Worn by Godskin Nobles, known for their seven-face aprons.

Strengthens the Noble Presence incantation.

Nobles are the most ancient apostles who are said to have assimilated inhuman physiology. Not unlike the crucible, the Erdtree in its primordial form.

items.name: Godskin Noble Trousers
items.description:
Trousers made by sewing together patches of smooth skin.
Subcutaneous fat makes them plump and soft.
Worn by Godskin Nobles.

Nobles are the most ancient apostles who are said to have assimilated inhuman physiology. Not unlike the crucible, the Erdtree in its primordial form.

items.name: Gold Bracelets
items.description:
Bracelets made in the image of Erdtree branches.
Minimal adornments made by Lord Goldmask's disciples.

Those disciples have long since left him.

items.name: Gold Waistwrap
items.description:
Waistwrap made in the image of Erdtree branches.
A minimal adornment made by Lord Goldmask's disciples.

Those disciples have long since left him.

items.name: Goldmask's Rags
items.description:
Worn rags that just barely cover the body.

Lord Goldmask felt no draw to the vain excesses of clothing; what use is finery to one who seeks greater brilliance?

items.name: Gravebird Anklets
items.description:
Stone anklets with a tinge of green. One of a set of armor pieces cast in the image of the Gravebird.

Gravebirds are ancient golems, created to guard the spiritgraves built where all manners of Death ultimately drift.

items.name: Gravebird Armor
items.description:
Stone armor with a tinge of green. One of a set of armor pieces cast in the image of the Gravebird.

Gravebirds are ancient golems, created to guard the spiritgraves built where all manners of Death ultimately drift.

items.name: Gravebird Bracelets
items.description:
Stone bracelets with a tinge of green. One of a set of armor pieces cast in the image of the Gravebird.

Gravebirds are ancient golems, created to guard the spiritgraves built where all manners of Death ultimately drift.

items.name: Gravebird Helm
items.description:
Stone helm with a tinge of green. One of a set of armor pieces cast in the image of the Gravebird.
Empowers spells which summon rings of spectral light.

Gravebirds are ancient golems, created to guard the spiritgraves built where all manners of Death ultimately drift.

items.name: Gravebird's Blackquill Armor
items.description:
Stone armor with a tinge of green. One of a set of armor pieces cast in the image of the Gravebird.
Featuring a cape of black Deathbird feathers, it enhances jumping attacks.

Gravebirds are ancient golems, created to guard the spiritgraves built where all manners of Death ultimately drift.

items.name: Gravekeeper Cloak
items.description:
Thick, bristly cloak that is the symbol of an underground gravekeeper.

Those who once fought for a living were driven from the colosseum, and becoming guardians of Erdtree Burial.

items.name: Gravekeeper Cloak (Altered)
items.description:
Defensive wear encircled by bronze snakes.
Worn by gladiators who were driven from the colosseum. The wearer becomes a slightly easier target for foes.

The snake is viewed as a traitor to the Erdtree, and the audience delighted in seeing these bronze effigies beaten and battered.

items.name: Great Horned Headband
items.description:
Headband decorated by a pair of great horns.
Worn by ancestral follower warriors.

The ancestral followers keep their distance from the Erdtree, awaiting new buds. They are certain to sprout from their very flesh, and indeed, their souls.

items.name: Greathelm
items.description:
Sturdy greathelm made from iron.

Though it is uncomfortably heavy and obstructs the vision of the wearer, it provides considerable damage negation.

items.name: Greathood
items.description:
Hood far larger than the head it is meant to cover.
A burial shroud of sorts for those who discover, at long last, the truth they sought.

Increases intelligence and faith to the detriment of HP.

"Yes, surely this is the moon that young Rennala gazed upon."

items.name: Greatjar
items.description:
A greatjar which fits comfortably over the head when upturned. Attire of the shamans who perform their worship at gaols.

Increases the power of thrown pots of all sizes.

They offer their prayers to the innards of the greatjars, such that they might be reborn one day into sainthood. This is the cycle of death and rebirth, taken into the hands of mortal men.

items.name: Greaves of Night
items.description:
Bottomless black greaves, cool to the touch.
Flowing lines in the seeming shape of a fingerprint adorn the surface. Imprisons the wearer in utterly lightless dark.

Bestowed upon those born deep underground, ordaining them as Swordhands of Night.

items.name: Greaves of Solitude
items.description:
Steel greaves of the Knights of the Solitary Gaol.
Part of a heavy armor set that covers the whole body in overlapping plates of steel.

The nameless mausoleums of the realm of shadow are said to hold the spirits of warriors who lost their names, or their hearts.

items.name: Guardian Bracers
items.description:
Engraved golden bracers.
Worn by the guardians of the Minor Erdtrees.

In accordance with an ancient pact with the Erdtree, it is said that their deaths led not to destruction, but instead to renewed, eternal life as guardians.

items.name: Guardian Garb
items.description:
Engraved golden garb.
Worn by the guardians of the Minor Erdtrees.

In accordance with an ancient pact with the Erdtree, it is said that their deaths led not to destruction, but instead to renewed, eternal life as guardians.

items.name: Guardian Garb (Full Bloom)
items.description:
Engraved golden garb.
Worn by the guardians of the Minor Erdtrees.

Raises the HP recovery effects of the Flask of Crimson Tears, but greatly lowers fire damage negation.

It is said that the blood-red flowers blooming on their backs mark the senescence of their ancient pact. Perhaps the guardians are part tree already.

items.name: Guardian Greaves
items.description:
Engraved golden greaves.
Worn by the guardians of the Minor Erdtrees.

In accordance with an ancient pact with the Erdtree, it is said that their deaths led not to destruction, but instead to renewed, eternal life as guardians.

items.name: Guardian Mask
items.description:
Engraved golden mask.
Worn by the guardians of the Minor Erdtrees.

In accordance with an ancient pact with the Erdtree, it is said that their deaths led not to destruction, but instead to renewed, eternal life as guardians.

items.name: Guilty Hood
items.description:
Coarse hooded cloak of olive brown.

The garb of those accused of lesser crimes, indicated by the collar of sharpened branches.

items.name: Haima Glintstone Crown
items.description:
One of the glintstone crowns bestowed upon Raya Lucaria scholars whose pursuits were deemed worthy.

Increases intelligence and strength to the detriment of FP.

Scholars of the Haima Conspectus sought the power to quell conflict, and to this end studied the sorceries of cannon fire and the gavel.

items.name: Haligtree Crest Surcoat
items.description:
Armor worn by soldiers sworn to the Haligtree.

The surcoat bears the crest of the Haligtree.
Though watered with Miquella's own blood since it was a sapling, the Haligtree ultimately failed to grow into an Erdtree.

items.name: Haligtree Gauntlets
items.description:
Gauntlets worn by soldiers sworn to the Haligtree.
Rust-worn and stained through unending conflict.

items.name: Haligtree Greaves
items.description:
Greaves worn by soldiers sworn to the Haligtree.
Rust-worn and stained through unending conflict.

items.name: Haligtree Helm
items.description:
Helm worn by soldiers sworn to the Haligtree.
An iron helm graced by a crown of unalloyed gold.

Increases faith.

items.name: Haligtree Knight Armor
items.description:
Armor worn by knights sworn to the Haligtree.

Its left breast is emblazoned with the crest of the Haligtree.
Though watered with Miquella's own blood since it was a sapling, the Haligtree ultimately failed to grow into an Erdtree.

items.name: Haligtree Knight Armor (Altered)
items.description:
Armor worn by knights sworn to the Haligtree.

Its left breast is emblazoned with the crest of the Haligtree.
Though watered with Miquella's own blood since it was a sapling, the Haligtree ultimately failed to grow into an Erdtree.

items.name: Haligtree Knight Gauntlets
items.description:
Gauntlets worn by knights sworn to the Haligtree.
Time has yet to dull their luster.

items.name: Haligtree Knight Greaves
items.description:
Greaves worn by knights sworn to the Haligtree.
Time has yet to dull their luster.

items.name: Haligtree Knight Helm
items.description:
Helm worn by knights sworn to the Haligtree.
Graced by a crown of unalloyed gold.

Increases faith.

items.name: Head
items.description: Bare head with no armor equipped.

items.name: Helm of Night
items.description:
Bottomless black helm, cool to the touch.
Flowing lines in the seeming shape of a fingerprint adorn the surface. Imprisons the wearer in utterly lightless dark.

Bestowed upon those born deep underground, ordaining them as Swordhands of Night.

items.name: Helm of Solitude
items.description:
Steel helm of the Knights of the Solitary Gaol.
Part of a heavy armor set that covers the whole body in overlapping plates of steel.

The nameless mausoleums of the realm of shadow are said to hold the spirits of warriors who lost their names, or their hearts.

items.name: Hierodas Glintstone Crown
items.description:
One of the glintstone crowns bestowed upon Raya Lucaria scholars whose pursuits were deemed worthy.

Increases intelligence and endurance to the detriment of FP.

The crown of Hierodas was granted to scholars who engaged in nomadic study away from the academy.

items.name: High Page Clothes
items.description:
Clothes of a page selected for special privileges by the noble they serve.

Traveling wear tailored with exquisite precision, to avoid any undue shame for the page's master.

items.name: High Page Clothes (Altered)
items.description:
Clothes of a page selected for special privileges by the noble they serve.

Traveling wear tailored with exquisite precision, to avoid any undue shame for the page's master.

items.name: High Page Hood
items.description:
Hood of a page selected for special privileges by the noble they serve.

The unassuming sack-like appearance befits their unseen and unknown stature.

items.name: High Priest Gloves
items.description:
Gloves of Count Ymir, High Priest.
Soft and well-tailored.

items.name: High Priest Hat
items.description:
The hat of Count Ymir, High Priest.

The circular design at the top represents the Greater Will and its lightless abyss, imparting increased intelligence and arcane to the wearer.

Though Count Ymir instructed Rellana in the sorcerous arts, he abandoned his allegiance to the moon.

"It was merely the closest of the celestial bodies. Nothing more."

items.name: High Priest Robe
items.description:
Robe of Count Ymir, High Priest.
Conceals the abundance of squirming beneath.

Gold embroidery decorates the purple cloth, with a jewelled ruff that sparkles like a flower wet with dew.

items.name: High Priest Undergarments
items.description:
Undergarments of Count Ymir, High Priest.
Soft and well-tailored.

items.name: Highland Attire
items.description:
Traditional garb of highland warriors, made from woven fabric and finished with a blue patterned cloth.

Highland warriors are known to be hunters of bears; to them, there is no act more glorious than the subjugation of a savage beast.

items.name: Highwayman Cloth Armor
items.description:
Hideously stained and ragged cloth armor.
Worn by former foot soldiers who have turned to banditry.

items.name: Highwayman Gauntlets
items.description:
Hideously stained and dented gauntlets.
Worn by former foot soldiers who have turned to banditry.

items.name: Highwayman Hood
items.description:
Hideously stained and ragged hood.
Worn by former foot soldiers who have turned to banditry.

items.name: Horned Warrior Armor
items.description:
Armor of the horned warriors, keepers of the tower.

The ochre fabric is draped over a chest-piece made to resemble the unclothed form of a hero from older times.

items.name: Horned Warrior Gauntlets
items.description: Gauntlets of the horned warriors, keepers of the tower, made from a thick metal.

items.name: Horned Warrior Greaves
items.description: Greaves of the horned warriors, keepers of the tower. Shaped to resemble the unclothed form of a hero from older times.

items.name: Horned Warrior Helm
items.description:
Helm featuring a crown of sturdy tangled horns, allowing the wearer to invoke divinity. Attire of the horned warriors, keepers of the tower.

Divine invocation bolsters the strength of the wearer, but causes the blessing of the Erdtree to become nauseating, reducing the restorative effect of drinking from a flask of sacred tears.

Focus is also troubled by wearing this helm.

items.name: Hoslow's Armor
items.description:
Garish silver armor decorated with red embellishments.
Passed down through the Hoslow family.

When Juno Hoslow received an invitation to the Volcano Manor, he discreetly refused.

"I have already walked many a road drenched in blood, yet never would I consider myself a champion."

items.name: Hoslow's Armor (Altered)
items.description:
Garish silver armor decorated with red embellishments.
Passed down through the Hoslow family.

When Juno Hoslow received an invitation to the Volcano Manor, he discreetly refused.

"I have already walked many a road drenched in blood, yet never would I consider myself a champion."

items.name: Hoslow's Gauntlets
items.description:
Garish silver gauntlets decorated with red embellishments.
Passed down through the Hoslow family.

When Juno Hoslow received an invitation to the Volcano Manor, he discreetly refused.

"I have already walked many a road drenched in blood, yet never would I consider myself a champion."

items.name: Hoslow's Greaves
items.description:
Garish silver greaves decorated with red embellishments.
Passed down through the Hoslow family.

When Juno Hoslow received an invitation to the Volcano Manor, he discreetly refused.

"I have already walked many a road drenched in blood, yet never would I consider myself a champion."

items.name: Hoslow's Helm
items.description:
A twin-tailed silver helm decorated with flowery adornments. Symbol of the head of the revered House of Hoslow.

Juno Hoslow had a younger brother who was all talk and no trousers.

His inability to commit to action was such that Juno inherited the Hoslow legacy without resistance, granting him the freedom to shower his little brother with adoration.

items.name: Igon's Armor
items.description:
Armor of the broken drake warrior Igon, from a set comprised of a miscellany of parts. Filthy belongings are attached to this tattered piece of protective-wear.

The poor scavenger of battlefields found honor through Dragon Communion.

items.name: Igon's Armor (Altered)
items.description:
Armor of the broken drake warrior Igon, from a set comprised of a miscellany of parts. Patched with scraps of cloth.

The poor scavenger of battlefields found honor through Dragon Communion.

items.name: Igon's Gauntlets
items.description:
Gauntlets of the broken drake warrior Igon.
No more than a mish-mash of tatters and remnants stripped from a corpse found in the aftermath of a battle.

items.name: Igon's Helm
items.description:
Helm of the broken drake warrior Igon, from a set of armor comprised of a miscellany of parts. This tattered protective-wear is shaped like a bugle.

The poor scavenger of battlefields found honor through Dragon Communion.

items.name: Igon's Helm (Altered)
items.description:
Helm of the broken drake warrior Igon, from a set of armor comprised of a miscellany of parts. Patched with scraps of cloth.

The poor scavenger of battlefields found honor through Dragon Communion.

items.name: Igon's Loincloth
items.description: Loincloth of the broken drake warrior Igon. Stripped from a corpse found in the aftermath of a battle, this scrap of cloth smells utterly foul.

items.name: Iji's Mirrorhelm
items.description:
Helm fashioned from a crystal looking-glass, said to have never left War Counselor Iji's head.
Easily broken and weak against striking attacks.

Worn by those committed to high treason, it wards off the intervention of the Greater Will and its vassal Fingers.

Iji was afraid. Terrified of his own treachery.

items.name: Imp Head (Cat)
items.description:
Head covering made from the largely unaltered head of an impish golem.

Resembling a cat, it holds trace amounts of feline intelligence.

items.name: Imp Head (Corpse)
items.description:
Head covering made from the largely unaltered head of an impish golem.

Resembling the visage of a corpse, it holds trace amounts of lingering faith.

items.name: Imp Head (Elder)
items.description:
Head covering made from the largely unaltered head of an impish golem.

Resembling an elder, it holds trace amounts of arcane knowledge.

items.name: Imp Head (Fanged)
items.description:
Head covering made from the largely unaltered head of an impish golem.

Resembling a fanged demon, it holds trace amounts of bestial strength.

items.name: Imp Head (Lion)
items.description:
Head covering made from the largely unaltered head of an impish golem.

Resembling a lion in appearance, life force faintly clings to it.

items.name: Imp Head (Long-Tongued)
items.description:
Head covering made from the largely unaltered head of an impish golem.

Resembling a long-tongued demon, it holds trace amounts of vexatious dexterity.

items.name: Imp Head (Wolf)
items.description:
Head covering made from the largely unaltered head of an impish golem.

Resembling a wolf, it holds trace amounts of lupine endurance.

items.name: Incantation Scarab
items.description:
Golden scarab worn directly on the head.
These scarabs roll clumps of incantations during their labors.

Slightly reduces the FP costs of incantations, but increases damage taken.

As a scarab approaches death, it abandons its rolled treasure and stretches its wings wide for the long journey to its home nest.

items.name: Iron Gauntlets
items.description: Ordinary iron gauntlets.

items.name: Iron Helmet
items.description:
An iron helmet showing rust on its edges.

Cloth covering the mouth and neck provides some resistance to poison and other irritants.

items.name: Iron Kasa
items.description:
Iron kasa of the man who calls himself Shabriri.
Crafted to imitate the woven straw hats worn in the Land of Reeds.

The man, once known as Yura, kept a woman in the deepest reaches of his heart.

items.name: Iron Rivet Armor
items.description:
Chest armor of Red Bear, whose name is lost to madness.
A vest reinforced with iron rivets.

After killing the great red bear in a blood-soaked bout, he became fascinated by the untainted glory of its naked strength.

"I wish to be a bear, no more, and no less."

items.name: Iron Rivet Gauntlets
items.description:
Gauntlets of Red Bear, whose name is lost to madness.
Reinforced with iron rivets.

After killing the great red bear in a blood-soaked bout, he became fascinated by the untainted glory of its naked strength.

"I wish to be a bear, no more, and no less."

items.name: Iron Rivet Greaves
items.description:
Greaves of Red Bear, whose name is lost to madness.
Reinforced with iron rivets.

After killing the great red bear in a blood-soaked bout, he became fascinated by the untainted glory of its naked strength.

"I wish to be a bear, no more, and no less."

items.name: Ivory-Draped Tabard
items.description:
Padded cloth armor with a shawl in the color of ivory draped over the shoulders.

Worn by foot soldiers sworn to the Haligtree.

items.name: Jar
items.description:
Jar that fits cleanly over the head when upturned.
Made with pride by Iron Fist Alexander.

In a uniquely jarlike gesture of friendship, it boosts the power of throwing pot items.

items.name: Juvenile Scholar Cap
items.description:
Cap worn by young academy scholars, the juveniles birthed anew by the amber egg of Queen Rennala, the head of Raya Lucaria Academy.

Yet their rebirth is not without imperfections, and thus do they repeat the process, eventually becoming utterly dependent upon it.

Rebirth is as sleep to them, and with each awakening, memory fades into oblivion.

items.name: Juvenile Scholar Robe
items.description:
Robe worn by young academy scholars, the juveniles birthed anew by the amber egg of Queen Rennala, the head of Raya Lucaria Academy.

Yet their rebirth is not without imperfections, and thus do they repeat the process, eventually becoming utterly dependent upon it.

Rebirth is as sleep to them, and with each awakening, memory fades into oblivion.

items.name: Kaiden Armor
items.description:
Armor worn by Kaiden sellswords.
Made with the pelt of a snow-wolf, which protects against the cold.

These hulking, fearless mercenaries, said to hail from the mountaintops of the wintry north, are adept at fighting on horseback.
Kaiden is the name of their home settlement.

items.name: Kaiden Gauntlets
items.description:
Gauntlets worn by Kaiden sellswords.

These hulking, fearless mercenaries, said to hail from the mountaintops of the wintry north, are adept at fighting on horseback.
Kaiden is the name of their home settlement.

items.name: Kaiden Helm
items.description:
Helm worn by Kaiden sellswords.

These hulking, fearless mercenaries, said to hail from the mountaintops of the wintry north, are adept at fighting on horseback.
Kaiden is the name of their home settlement.

items.name: Kaiden Trousers
items.description:
Trousers worn by Kaiden sellswords.

These hulking, fearless mercenaries, said to hail from the mountaintops of the wintry north, are adept at fighting on horseback.
Kaiden is the name of their home settlement.

items.name: Karolos Glintstone Crown
items.description:
One of the glintstone crowns bestowed upon Raya Lucaria scholars whose pursuits were deemed worthy.

Increases intelligence to the detriment of stamina.

The Karolos Conspectus is the oldest of the academy's lineages of study, begat by the sorcerer Azur. Scholars who follow in his footsteps pursue the mysteries of comets.

items.name: Knight Armor
items.description:
Iron armor of an unknown knight.
It is made of thin iron plate.

Such metal armor is heavy, but provides considerable damage negation.

items.name: Knight Gauntlets
items.description:
Iron gauntlets of an unknown knight.
It is made of thin iron plate.

Such metal armor is heavy, but provides considerable damage negation.

items.name: Knight Greaves
items.description:
Iron greaves of an unknown knight.
It is made of thin iron plate.

Such metal armor is heavy, but provides considerable damage negation.

items.name: Knight Helm
items.description:
Iron helm of an unknown knight.
It is made of thin iron plate.

Such metal armor is heavy, but provides considerable damage negation.

items.name: Land of Reeds Armor
items.description:
Armor made from strips of iron fastened together.
Worn by warriors of the Land of Reeds.

The grimy outer mantle is made from withered reeds from the warrior's birthplace.
Perhaps its comforts extend to nostalgic thoughts of home.

items.name: Land of Reeds Armor (Altered)
items.description:
Armor made from strips of iron fastened together.
Worn by warriors of the Land of Reeds.

The Land of Reeds has long been locked in a miserable civil war, during which time it has remained alienated from the cultures of its neighbors. Little wonder that the entire nation has succumbed to blood-soaked madness, or so it is said.

items.name: Land of Reeds Gauntlets
items.description:
Gauntlets wrapped in tough leather.
Worn by warriors of the Land of Reeds.

items.name: Land of Reeds Greaves
items.description:
Greaves wrapped in tough leather.
Worn by warriors of the Land of Reeds.

items.name: Land of Reeds Helm
items.description:
Helm made from strips of iron fastened together.
Worn by warriors of the Land of Reeds.

The Land of Reeds has long been locked in a miserable civil war, during which time it has remained alienated from the cultures of its neighbors. Little wonder that the entire nation has succumbed to blood-soaked madness, or so it is said.

items.name: Lazuli Glintstone Crown
items.description:
One of the glintstone crowns bestowed upon Raya Lucaria scholars whose pursuits were deemed worthy.

Increases intelligence and dexterity to the detriment of HP.

Scholars of the Lazuli Conspectus study Carian sorceries—a heterodox pursuit that views the moon as equal to the stars.

items.name: Lazuli Robe
items.description:
Robe worn by scholars of the Lazuli Conspectus, singular among the greater Raya Lucaria Academy.

These scholars, who sought to master Carian sorcery, instead learned to see the moon as equal to the stars.
This robe, in the hue of the full moon, signifies their heresy.

items.name: Leather Arm Wraps
items.description:
Arm wraps worn by highland warriors, made of sturdy leather and fastened with winding straps.

Highland warriors are known to be hunters of bears; to them, there is no act more glorious than the subjugation of a savage beast.

items.name: Leather Armor
items.description:
Lightweight and battle-proven leather armor worn by a savvy soldier.

Many admire the wearer of this armor for his chivalrous and forthright spirit.

items.name: Leather Boots
items.description:
Lightweight and battle-proven leather boots worn by a savvy soldier.

Many admire the wearer of this armor for his chivalrous and forthright spirit.

items.name: Leather Crown
items.description:
Helm worn by highland warriors, pieced together using leather. The white favor represents their home settlement.

Highland warriors are known to be hunters of bears; to them, there is no act more glorious than the subjugation of a savage beast.

items.name: Leather Gloves
items.description:
Lightweight and battle-proven leather gloves worn by a savvy soldier.

Many admire the wearer of this armor for his chivalrous and forthright spirit.

items.name: Leather Headband
items.description:
Headband worn by highland warriors, made of woven leather. The white favor represents their home settlement.

Highland warriors are known to be hunters of bears; to them, there is no act more glorious than the subjugation of a savage beast.

items.name: Leather Leg Wraps
items.description:
Leg wraps worn by highland warriors, made of sturdy leather and fastened with winding straps. The addition of animal pelt keeps the wearer warm.

Highland warriors are known to be hunters of bears; to them, there is no act more glorious than the subjugation of a savage beast.

items.name: Leather Trousers
items.description:
Well-made leather trousers.

The lower legs are each bound in cord for ease of movement.

items.name: Leather-Draped Tabard
items.description:
Padded cloth armor with a leather shawl draped over the shoulders.

Widely issued to foot soldiers in a lord's army.

items.name: Leda's Armor
items.description:
Chest armor of Needle Knight Leda.

Slightly strengthens attacks following a dodge roll or backstep, as well as dash attacks.

Embroidered with a golden crossed-tree motif, the chalk white cloak and surcoat symbolize the honor of the Needle Knights.

"Kindly Miquella fashioned us as his needles to quell all, to ward away all."

items.name: Legs
items.description: Bare legs with no armor equipped.

items.name: Leyndell Knight Armor
items.description:
Armor worn by knights sworn to defend the royal capital of Leyndell.

Its left breast is emblazoned with a symbol of Erdtree Worship, said to have once been imbued with an incantation of protection.

items.name: Leyndell Knight Armor (Altered)
items.description:
Armor worn by knights sworn to defend the royal capital of Leyndell.

Its left breast is emblazoned with a symbol of Erdtree Worship, said to have once been imbued with an incantation of protection.

items.name: Leyndell Knight Gauntlets
items.description:
Gauntlets worn by knights sworn to defend the royal capital of Leyndell.
Time has yet to dull their luster.

items.name: Leyndell Knight Greaves
items.description:
Greaves worn by knights sworn to defend the royal capital of Leyndell.
Time has yet to dull their luster.

items.name: Leyndell Knight Helm
items.description:
Helm worn by knights sworn to defend the royal capital of Leyndell.

The golden canopy represents the honor of standing among the tree's defenders.

items.name: Leyndell Soldier Gauntlets
items.description:
Gauntlets worn by soldiers sworn to defend the royal capital of Leyndell.
Rust-worn and stained through unending conflict.

items.name: Leyndell Soldier Greaves
items.description:
Greaves worn by soldiers sworn to defend the royal capital of Leyndell.
Rust-worn and stained through unending conflict.

items.name: Leyndell Soldier Helm
items.description:
Helm worn by soldiers sworn to defend the royal capital of Leyndell.
Made from durable iron, layered with a chainmail coif beneath.

items.name: Lionel's Armor
items.description:
Round iron armor with a banner extending from its back.
Worn by Lionel the Lionhearted.

When this chivalrous, dauntless knight met Fia, who had been driven from her home, he declared himself to be her father.

items.name: Lionel's Armor (Altered)
items.description:
Round iron armor.
Worn by Lionel the Lionhearted.

When this chivalrous, dauntless knight met Fia, who had been driven from her home, he declared himself to be her father.

items.name: Lionel's Gauntlets
items.description:
Rounded iron gauntlets.
Worn by Lionel the Lionhearted.

When this chivalrous, dauntless knight met Fia, who had been driven from her home, he declared himself to be her father.

items.name: Lionel's Greaves
items.description:
Rounded iron greaves.
Worn by Lionel the Lionhearted.

When this chivalrous, dauntless knight met Fia, who had been driven from her home, he declared himself her father.

items.name: Lionel's Helm
items.description:
Round iron helm with a distinctive large brim.
Worn by Lionel the Lionhearted.

When this chivalrous, dauntless knight met Fia, who had been driven from her home, he declared himself to be her father.

items.name: Lord of Blood's Robe
items.description:
Attire of Mohg, Lord of Blood, embroidered with an extravagant gold emblem on black cloth.

The dress of a Luminary, the reigning lord and hierarch of the coming dynasty of Mohgwyn. Or perhaps, of a raving lunatic.

items.name: Lord of Blood's Robe (Altered)
items.description:
Attire of Mohg, Lord of Blood, embroidered with an extravagant gold emblem on black cloth.

The dress of a Luminary, the reigning lord and hierarch of the coming dynasty of Mohgwyn. Or perhaps, of a raving lunatic.

items.name: Lusat's Glintstone Crown
items.description:
The giant blue glintstone crown worn by Lusat, primeval current sorcerer.

This crown replaced Lusat's brain and skull altogether, and now, removed from his body, it is all but dead. What power remains within raises the potency of Lusat's primeval current sorceries at the cost of additional FP consumption.

items.name: Lusat's Manchettes
items.description:
Manchettes corroded by blue glintstones.
Worn by Lusat, primeval current sorcerer.

Lusat had reached a near-inorganic state.

items.name: Lusat's Robe
items.description:
A robe reserved for grand masters at the Academy of Raya Lucaria.
Corroded by blue glintstones.

Since the grand masters Azur and Lusat were driven from the academy, no one has achieved their formerly-held rank.

items.name: Malenia's Armor
items.description:
Armor made of unalloyed gold.
Worn by Malenia, Blade of Miquella.

Malenia awaited Miquella at the foot of the husk.

"My brother will keep his promise. He possesses the wisdom, the allure, of a god—he is the most fearsome Empyrean of all."

items.name: Malenia's Armor (Altered)
items.description:
Armor made of unalloyed gold.
Worn by Malenia, Blade of Miquella.

Malenia awaited Miquella at the foot of the husk.

"My brother will keep his promise. He possesses the wisdom, the allure, of a god—he is the most fearsome Empyrean of all."

items.name: Malenia's Gauntlet
items.description:
Gauntlet made of unalloyed gold.
Worn by Malenia, Blade of Miquella.

Malenia awaited Miquella at the foot of the husk.

"My brother will keep his promise. He possesses the wisdom, the allure, of a god—he is the most fearsome Empyrean of all."

items.name: Malenia's Greaves
items.description:
Greaves made of unalloyed gold.
Worn by Malenia, Blade of Miquella.

Malenia awaited Miquella at the foot of the husk.

"My brother will keep his promise. He possesses the wisdom, the allure, of a god—he is the most fearsome Empyrean of all."

items.name: Malenia's Winged Helm
items.description:
Winged helm made of unalloyed gold.
Worn by Malenia, Blade of Miquella.

Malenia awaited Miquella at the foot of the husk.

"My brother will keep his promise. He possesses the wisdom, the allure, of a god—he is the most fearsome Empyrean of all."

items.name: Malformed Dragon Armor
items.description:
Malformed golden armor.
Adorned with various dragon imagery and worn by the misshapen Tree Sentinels.

After the great ancient dragon Gransax attacked, the sentinels had an epiphany. The only way to truly protect the Erdtree was to become dragons themselves.

items.name: Malformed Dragon Gauntlets
items.description:
Malformed golden gauntlets.
Adorned with various dragon imagery and worn by the misshapen Tree Sentinels.

After the great ancient dragon Gransax attacked, the sentinels had an epiphany. The only way to truly protect the Erdtree was to become dragons themselves.

items.name: Malformed Dragon Greaves
items.description:

Adorned with various dragon imagery and worn by the misshapen Tree Sentinels.

items.description:

Adorned with various dragon imagery and worn by the misshapen Tree Sentinels.

After the great ancient dragon Gransax attacked, the sentinels had an epiphany. The only way to truly protect the Erdtree was to become dragons themselves.

items.name: Maliketh's Armor
items.description:
Beast's armor made of black iron and decorated with gold.
Worn by Maliketh the Black Blade.

Maliketh, Queen Marika's loyal half-brother, bore a blade imbued with Destined Death, and there was not one demigod who did not fear him.

Champions knew what was at stake.
Indeed, that is what made them champions.

items.name: Marais Mask
items.description:
Mask in the image of a white-haired young noble.
Customarily worn by the head of House Marais.
Increases arcane.

The Marais family has a dual history spanning generations, serving as both executioners and castellans of the Shaded Castle. This mask bears the likeness of the first of their line.

items.name: Marais Robe
items.description:
Robe with a black mantle across the shoulders.
Customarily worn by the head of House Marais.

The sons of House Marais are all sickly born.
Little wonder that Maleigh Marais would be so beguiled by the beautiful and fierce goddess who was born into rot.

items.name: Marionette Soldier Armor
items.description:
Armor of metal bands arranged in a lattice.
Worn by marionette soldiers, crafted to serve the sorcerers.

The construction of this armor is remarkably crude, now rusted over and severely dented.

For a doll, the only thing that matters is that it does not break.

items.name: Marionette Soldier Birdhelm
items.description:
Metal helm formed in the likeness of the face of a bird.
Worn by avionette soldiers, crafted to serve the sorcerers.

The construction of this helm is remarkably crude.

For a doll, the only thing that matters is that it does not break.

items.name: Marionette Soldier Helm
items.description:
Cylindrical helm of plate metal reinforced with a lattice.
Worn by marionette soldiers, crafted to serve the sorcerers.

The construction of this helm is remarkably crude.

For a doll, the only thing that matters is that it does not break.

items.name: Mask of Confidence
items.description:
Mask with the mouth sewn shut with gold thread.
Increases arcane.

When Radagon married Rennala, he ordered the Carian magic preceptors to don these masks. To make it clear that all of their matters were to be kept strictly private.

items.name: Mausoleum Gauntlets
items.description:
Gauntlets worn by headless soldiers who endlessly guard the Wandering Mausoleum.
Rust-worn and stained through unending conflict.

items.name: Mausoleum Greaves
items.description:
Greaves worn by headless soldiers who endlessly guard the Wandering Mausoleum.
Rust-worn and stained through unending conflict.

items.name: Mausoleum Knight Armor
items.description:
Armor worn by headless knights who endlessly guard the Wandering Mausoleum.

The wing-shaped ornaments on its back evoke the Deathbird. A self-inflicted curse that ties the spirits of these loyal knights to the land, having willingly beheaded themselves so that they may serve their masters in death.

items.name: Mausoleum Knight Armor (Altered)
items.description:
Armor worn by headless knights who endlessly guard the Wandering Mausoleum.

The wing-shaped ornaments on its back evoke the Deathbird. A self-inflicted curse that ties the spirits of these loyal knights to the land, having willingly beheaded themselves so that they may serve their masters in death.

items.name: Mausoleum Knight Gauntlets
items.description:
Gauntlets worn by headless knights who endlessly guard the Wandering Mausoleum.
Time has yet to dull their luster.

items.name: Mausoleum Knight Greaves
items.description:
Greaves worn by headless knights who endlessly guard the Wandering Mausoleum.
Time has yet to dull their luster.

items.name: Mausoleum Surcoat
items.description:
Armor worn by headless soldiers who endlessly guard the Wandering Mausoleum.

The surcoat depicts the mausoleum bell, which rings in constant mourning for the soulless demigods.

items.name: Messmer Soldier Armor
items.description:
Armor worn by soldiers who serve Messmer the Impaler. A ragged cloak is draped over rusted mail.

Though the chestpiece features a Scadutree motif, gold has been used for its engraving. A small consolation to those forced to wage a war without grace or honor.

items.name: Messmer Soldier Armor (Altered)
items.description:
Armor worn by soldiers who serve Messmer the Impaler. The mail has rusted while fighting in unending war.

Though the chestpiece features a Scadutree motif, gold has been used for its engraving. A small consolation to those forced to wage a war without grace or honor.

items.name: Messmer Soldier Gauntlets
items.description: Gauntlets worn by soldiers who serve Messmer the Impaler, rusted and crusted in filth from fighting in unending war.

items.name: Messmer Soldier Greaves
items.description: Greaves worn by soldiers who serve Messmer the Impaler, rusted and crusted in filth from fighting in unending war.

items.name: Messmer Soldier Helm
items.description:
Helm worn by soldiers who serve Messmer the Impaler. The iron helm features a visor.

Though the engraving upon the forehead is a Scadutree design, it is etched in gold. A small consolation to those forced to wage a war without grace or honor.

items.name: Messmer's Armor
items.description:
Black armor of Messmer the Impaler.
Draped with a red cloak bearing his crest embroidered.

On his mother's wishes, Messmer made himself a symbol of fear, undertaking the cleansing crusade she desired.

"Direct thy maledictions, thine ire, and thy grief towards me alone."

items.name: Messmer's Gauntlets
items.description:
Black gauntlets of Messmer the Impaler.

On his mother's wishes, Messmer made himself a symbol of fear, undertaking the cleansing crusade she desired.

"Direct thy maledictions, thine ire, and thy grief towards me alone."

items.name: Messmer's Greaves
items.description:
Black greaves of Messmer the Impaler.

On his mother's wishes, Messmer made himself a symbol of fear, undertaking the cleansing crusade she desired.

"Direct thy maledictions, thine ire, and thy grief towards me alone."

items.name: Messmer's Helm
items.description:
Black helm of Messmer the Impaler, crowned with two intertwined winged serpents.
Slightly enhances incantations of Messmer's flame as well as Fire Knight skills.

The winged snakes were Messmer's constant companions.

They were there when the base serpent was sealed away behind his eye. They were there through his eternity of suffering. They will accompany him yet, in his hideous new form, born when he destroyed the grace granted by his mother. They have accepted his fate as much as he.

items.name: Messmer's Helm (Altered)
items.description:
Black helm of Messmer the Impaler, crowned with two intertwined winged serpents.
Slightly enhances incantations of Messmer's flame as well as Fire Knight skills.

The winged snakes were Messmer's constant companions.

They were there when the base serpent was sealed away behind his eye. They were there through his eternity of suffering. They will accompany him yet, in his hideous new form, born when he destroyed the grace granted by his mother. They have accepted his fate as much as he.

items.name: Mushroom Arms
items.description:
Mushrooms found growing all over the body.
These overgrown mushrooms have colonized the arms.

To those enraptured by the scarlet rot, they are holy vestments that root one to the earth.

items.name: Mushroom Body
items.description:
Mushrooms found growing all over the body.
These overgrown mushrooms have colonized the torso.

To those enraptured by the scarlet rot, they are holy vestments that root one to the earth.

items.name: Mushroom Crown
items.description:
Mushrooms found growing all over the body.
These overgrown mushrooms form a towering headpiece.

Raises attack power when something nearby suffers from poison or rot.

Long ago, great lords served the scarlet rot. Perhaps such fungal bodies served as their crowns.

items.name: Mushroom Head
items.description:
Mushrooms found growing all over the body.
These overgrown mushrooms have colonized the head.

To those enraptured by the scarlet rot, they are holy vestments that root one to the earth.

items.name: Mushroom Legs
items.description:
Mushrooms found growing all over the body.
These overgrown mushrooms have colonized the legs.

To those enraptured by the scarlet rot, they are holy vestments that root one to the earth.

items.name: Navy Hood
items.description:
A hooded cloak of deep navy.
Worn by expatriated royalty.
Increases mind.

Such cloaks were gifted to those who departed on missions to faraway lands, from which they would never return. But what choice did they have, having seen the guidance of grace?

items.name: Night Maiden Armor
items.description:
Armor worn by the nightmaidens of the Eternal City.
Indicates the highest clerical rank, and includes a silk cape.

Long ago, the Nox invoked the ire of the Greater Will, and were banished deep underground. Now they live under a false night sky, in eternal anticipation of their liege. Of the coming age of the stars. And their Lord of Night.

items.name: Night Maiden Twin Crown
items.description:
Twin crowns worn by the nightmaidens of the Eternal City.
Indicates the highest clerical rank, and hides the eyes with silk.

Long ago, the Nox invoked the ire of the Greater Will, and were banished deep underground. Now they live under a false night sky, in eternal anticipation of their liege. Of the coming age of the stars. And their Lord of Night.

items.name: Night's Cavalry Armor
items.description:
Pitch-black armor thinly painted with dried blood.
Worn by the Night's Cavalry who ride funeral steeds.

The Night's Cavalry, who now wander the dim roads of night, were once led by the Fell Omen and were deliverers of death for great warriors, knights, and champions.

items.name: Night's Cavalry Armor (Altered)
items.description:
Pitch-black armor thinly painted with dried blood.
Worn by the Night's Cavalry who ride funeral steeds.

items.name: Night's Cavalry Helm
items.description:

Worn by the Night's Cavalry who ride funeral steeds.

items.name: Night's Cavalry Helm (Altered)
items.description:

The Night's Cavalry, who now wander the dim roads of night, were once led by the Fell Omen and were deliverers of death for great warriors, knights, and champions.

items.name: Noble's Gloves
items.description:
Gloves of plush leather.
Worn by expatriated royalty.

A gift of such rare beauty, a royal wouldn't disgrace their illustrious heritage even if found dead, in a ditch, in the middle of nowhere, while wearing such splendid raiment.

items.name: Noble's Traveling Garb
items.description:
Traveling attire fashioned from metallic white silk thread. Worn by expatriated royalty.

A gift of such rare beauty, a royal wouldn't disgrace their illustrious heritage even if found dead, in a ditch, in the middle of nowhere, while wearing such splendid raiment.

items.name: Noble's Trousers
items.description:
White trousers of superior craftsmanship.
Worn by expatriated royalty.

A gift of such rare beauty, a royal wouldn't disgrace their illustrious heritage even if found dead, in a ditch, in the middle of nowhere, while wearing such splendid raiment.

items.name: Nomadic Merchant's Chapeau
items.description:
Chapeau of the nomadic merchants.
Decorated with tiny gems in a wide spectrum of colors.

These merchants once thrived as the Great Caravan, but after being accused of heretical beliefs, their entire clan was rounded up and buried alive far underground.

Then, they chanted a curse of despair, and summoned the flame of frenzy.

items.name: Nomadic Merchant's Finery
items.description:
Finery of the nomadic merchants.
Decorated with tiny gems in a wide spectrum of colors.

These merchants once thrived as the Great Caravan, but after being accused of heretical beliefs, their entire clan was rounded up and buried alive far underground.

Then, they chanted a curse of despair, and summoned the flame of frenzy.

items.name: Nox Bracelets
items.description:
Monastic bracelets of the Eternal City.

Long ago, the Nox invoked the ire of the Greater Will, and were banished deep underground. Now they live under a false night sky, in eternal anticipation of their liege. Of the coming age of the stars. And their Lord of Night.

items.name: Nox Greaves
items.description:
Monastic greaves of the Eternal City.

Long ago, the Nox invoked the ire of the Greater Will, and were banished deep underground. Now they live under a false night sky, in eternal anticipation of their liege. Of the coming age of the stars. And their Lord of Night.

items.name: Nox Mirrorhelm
items.description:
Helm fashioned from a crystal looking-glass.
One among the Eternal City's ritual implements.
Easily broken and weak against striking attacks.

Worn by those committed to high treason, it wards off the intervention of the Greater Will and its vassal Fingers.

items.name: Nox Monk Armor
items.description:
Armor worn by the monks of the Eternal City, with a silk cape attached.

Long ago, the Nox invoked the ire of the Greater Will, and were banished deep underground. Now they live under a false night sky, in eternal anticipation of their liege. Of the coming age of the stars. And their Lord of Night.

items.description:

items.description:
