Long ago, the Nox invoked the ire of the Greater Will, and were banished deep underground. Now they live under a false night sky, in eternal anticipation of their liege. Of the coming age of the stars. And their Lord of Night.

items.name: Nox Swordstress Armor
items.description:
Armor worn by swordstresses of the Eternal City.
These women are the personal guards of the nightmaidens, and wear silk capes.

Long ago, the Nox invoked the ire of the Greater Will, and were banished deep underground. Now they live under a false night sky, in eternal anticipation of their liege. Of the coming age of the stars. And their Lord of Night.

items.name: Nox Swordstress Armor (Altered)
items.description:
Armor worn by swordstresses of the Eternal City.
These women are the personal guards of the nightmaidens.

Long ago, the Nox invoked the ire of the Greater Will, and were banished deep underground. Now they live under a false night sky, in eternal anticipation of their liege. Of the coming age of the stars. And their Lord of Night.

items.name: Nox Swordstress Crown
items.description:
Crown worn by swordstresses of the Eternal City.
These women are the personal guards of the nightmaidens, and the silk hides their eyes.

Long ago, the Nox invoked the ire of the Greater Will, and were banished deep underground. Now they live under a false night sky, in eternal anticipation of their liege. Of the coming age of the stars. And their Lord of Night.

items.name: Nox Swordstress Crown (Altered)
items.description:
Crown worn by swordstresses of the Eternal City.
The silk eye covering is removed, flaunting convention.

Long ago, the Nox invoked the ire of the Greater Will, and were banished deep underground. Now they live under a false night sky, in eternal anticipation of their liege. Of the coming age of the stars. And their Lord of Night.

items.name: Oathseeker Knight Armor
items.description:
Oathseeker Knight chest armor.
Black with gold ornamentation.

These knights set off on quests of discovery, hoping to find by themselves an oath of their own choosing to serve in perfect, lifelong devotion.

items.name: Oathseeker Knight Gauntlets
items.description:
Oathseeker Knight gauntlets.
Black with gold ornamentation.

These knights set off on quests of discovery, hoping to find by themselves an oath of their own choosing to serve in perfect, lifelong devotion.

items.name: Oathseeker Knight Greaves
items.description:
Oathseeker Knight greaves.
Black with gold ornamentation.

These knights set off on quests of discovery, hoping to find by themselves an oath of their own choosing to serve in perfect, lifelong devotion.

items.name: Oathseeker Knight Helm
items.description:
An Oathseeker Knight helm.
Black with gold ornamentation.

These knights set off on quests of discovery, hoping to find by themselves an oath of their own choosing to serve in perfect, lifelong devotion.

items.name: Octopus Head
items.description:
A land octopus whelp worn directly on the head.
Has a lingering warmth reminiscent of human skin.

Those who can withstand the smell will find its organic elasticity excellent for negating strikes.

items.name: Official's Attire
items.description:
Grubby blue robe worn by magisterial officials to carry out their grim tasks.

Surveillance, executions, gruesome rituals… The darkest duties drive the wheels of mankind.

items.name: Okina Mask
items.description:
A wooden mask that depicts an old man baring his teeth. The source of the sobriquet of the great swordsman of the Land of Reeds.
Raises dexterity as it lowers focus.

The more he sharpened his mind, the more the absurdities of the world came into stark relief. And so Okina renounced it all, and rose to a higher plane. There was only himself. His katana. And its mastery.

Before long, Okina became a demon of a swordsman.

items.name: Old Aristocrat Cowl
items.description:
Cowl made of soft cloth.
Travel attire worn by nobles in the capital. Garb favored by the aged.

Abandoning their birthplace after the Shattering, these undead wanderers are the pitiful product of unending life.

items.name: Old Aristocrat Gown
items.description:
Gown of soft cloth adorned with fine gold embroidery.
Travel attire worn by nobles in the capital. Garb favored by the aged.

Abandoning their birthplace after the Shattering, these undead wanderers are the pitiful product of unending life.

items.name: Old Aristocrat Shoes
items.description:
Hard-wearing shoes made of leather.
Travel attire worn by nobles in the capital. Garb favored by the aged.

Abandoning their birthplace after the Shattering, these undead wanderers are the pitiful product of unending life.

items.name: Old Sorcerer's Legwraps
items.description:
Ragged waistcloth that extends to the thighs.
Common amongst old-fashioned sorcerers.

items.name: Olivinus Glintstone Crown
items.description:
One of the glintstone crowns bestowed upon Raya Lucaria scholars whose pursuits were deemed worthy.

Increases intelligence to the detriment of HP.

The lineage of the Olivinus Conspectus began with the sorcerer Lusat, and its adherents continue his study of meteors.

items.name: Omen Armor
items.description:
Malformed armor resembling an Omen with its horns cut off.

Worn by the Dung Eater.
The heavy, sun-shaped medallion represents both the guidance he once saw, and the ring to which it will one day lead.

items.name: Omen Gauntlets
items.description:
Malformed gauntlets resembling an Omen with its horns cut off.

Worn by the Dung Eater, their form is a vision of the landscape of his mind, and of his appearance as he wished to see it.

The heart of an Omen without the body to match; could there be any crueler existence?
What does it matter, then, if the curse claims it all?

items.name: Omen Greaves
items.description:
Malformed greaves resembling an Omen with its horns cut off.

Worn by the Dung Eater, their form is a vision of the landscape of his mind, and of his appearance as he wished to see it.

The heart of an Omen without the body to match; could there be any crueler existence?
What does it matter, then, if the curse claims it all?

items.name: Omen Helm
items.description:
Malformed helm resembling an Omen with its horns cut off.

Worn by the Dung Eater, its form is a vision of the landscape of his mind, and of his appearance as he wished to see it.

The heart of an Omen without the body to match; could there be any crueler existence?
What does it matter, then, if the curse claims it all?

items.name: Omenkiller Boots
items.description: Stiff leather boots worn by the Omenkillers.

items.name: Omenkiller Long Gloves
items.description: Long, stiff leather gloves worn by the Omenkillers.

items.name: Omenkiller Robe
items.description:
Robe worn by the Omenkillers, butchers of twisted conscience.

Its thick apron is worn in remembrance of Rollo, the progenitor of the Omenkillers and a perfumer of antiquity.

items.name: Omensmirk Mask
items.description:
Mask with long, hideously twisted horns worn by the Omenkillers.
Increases strength.

Bears the smirking face of an elder, twisted in wicked delight.

This visage is carved in the image of the evil spirits that haunt the Omen in their nightmares.

items.name: Page Garb
items.description:
Garb worn by pages who serve the nobility and are mindful to keep them out of harm's way.

Traveling wear tailored with exquisite precision, to avoid any undue shame for the page's master.

items.name: Page Garb (Altered)
items.description:
Garb worn by pages who serve the nobility and are mindful to keep them out of harm's way.

Traveling wear tailored with exquisite precision, to avoid any undue shame for the page's master.

items.name: Page Hood
items.description:
Hood worn by pages who serve the nobility and are mindful to keep them out of harm's way.

The unassuming sack-like appearance befits their unseen and unknown stature.

items.name: Page Trousers
items.description:
Trousers worn by pages who serve the nobility and are mindful to keep them out of harm's way.

Traveling wear tailored with exquisite precision, to avoid any undue shame for the page's master.

items.name: Pelt of Ralva
items.description:
The pelt of Ralva the Great Red Bear, worn upon the head without modification.

Enhances incantations of what is jokingly called "Bear Communion."

This untreated hide, won at the end of a bloody bout, is just the thing to make a wild bear out of a warrior.

items.name: Perfumer Gloves
items.description:
Gloves of an Erdtree Capital perfumer.

In times past, the role of perfumer was much respected; a blessed apothecary in the eyes of the many. But after entering the battlefields of the Shattering they performed no such role, trading their aromatics for poisons and explosives.

items.name: Perfumer Hood
items.description:
Hood of an Erdtree Capital perfumer.

In times past, the role of perfumer was much respected; a blessed apothecary in the eyes of the many. But after entering the battlefields of the Shattering they performed no such role, trading their aromatics for poisons and explosives.

items.name: Perfumer Robe
items.description:
Robe of an Erdtree Capital perfumer.

The thick front apron embroidered with a depiction of the Erdtree is proof of mastery of the apothecarial arts, and its weight symbolizes the onus of both pride and responsibility.

items.name: Perfumer Robe (Altered)
items.description:
Robe of an Erdtree Capital perfumer.

The thick front apron embroidered with a depiction of the Erdtree is proof of mastery of the apothecarial arts, and its weight symbolizes the onus of both pride and responsibility.

items.name: Perfumer Sarong
items.description:
Sarong of an Erdtree Capital perfumer.

In times past, the role of perfumer was much respected; a blessed apothecary in the eyes of the many. But after entering the battlefields of the Shattering they performed no such role, trading their aromatics for poisons and explosives.

items.name: Perfumer's Traveling Garb
items.description:
Garb of a traveling perfumer of no renown.

The thick front apron, the badge of a perfumer, has been replaced with a more simple one made from soft leather.

items.name: Perfumer's Traveling Garb (Altered)
items.description:
Garb of a traveling perfumer of no renown.

The thick front apron, the badge of a perfumer, has been replaced with a more simple one made from soft leather.

items.name: Preceptor's Big Hat
items.description:
Large hat with the movements of the stars drawn on the inside of the brim.
Worn by the magic preceptors who served the Carian royals.

Increases mind to the detriment of stamina.

Glintstone sorcerers are the descendants of astrologers, a fact that the Carians remain aware of. Even if their fate has been long severed from the stars.

items.name: Preceptor's Gloves
items.description:
Gloves of the magic preceptors who serve the Carian royals.
Black and perfectly discreet.

items.name: Preceptor's Long Gown
items.description:
A long, bright blue gown with the movements of the stars drawn upon it.
Worn by the magic preceptors who served the Carian royals.

Glintstone sorcerers are the descendants of astrologers, a fact that the Carians remain aware of. Even if their fate has been long severed from the stars.

items.name: Preceptor's Long Gown (Altered)
items.description: Modest garb, previously worn under a long, bright blue gown with the movements of the stars drawn upon it.

items.name: Preceptor's Trousers
items.description:
Trousers of the magic preceptors who serve the Carian royals.
Black and perfectly discreet.

items.name: Prisoner Clothing
items.description:
Tattered clothing.
Worn by a prisoner convicted of an appalling crime.

Never once washed, every fiber is filthy.

items.name: Prisoner Iron Mask
items.description:
Iron mask forced on a prisoner convicted of an appalling crime.
Thick, heavy, and utterly stifling.

A foul creation designed to torment the wearer, either slowly fermenting hatred within their heart, or a spiritual fervor that is near indistinguishable from it.

items.name: Prisoner Trousers
items.description:
Tattered trousers.
Worn by a prisoner convicted of an appalling crime.

Never once washed, every fiber is filthy.
The smell is beyond belief.

items.name: Prophet Blindfold
items.description:
Blindfold of exiled prophets who foretold misfortune—and were persecuted and driven from their homes as a result.

Why hesitate, if the path leading to the future is clear? Just close your eyes, and walk.

items.name: Prophet Robe
items.description:
Robe of exiled prophets who foretold misfortune—and were persecuted and driven from their homes as a result.

The shackles around the neck warn passersby not to lend an ear to their sermons.

items.name: Prophet Robe (Altered)
items.description:
Robe of exiled prophets who foretold misfortune—and were persecuted and driven from their homes as a result.

Made from rough fabric that scrapes against the skin like a sharpening file.

items.name: Prophet Trousers
items.description:
Trousers of exiled prophets who foretold misfortune—and were persecuted and driven from their homes as a result.

Made from rough fabric that scrapes against the skin like a sharpening file.

items.name: Pumpkin Helm
items.description:
An oval helm large enough to cover any head.
Very heavy and very hard.

Reduces damage from headshots and impacts.

The inside of the helm is pitch black, keeping the crazed warrior within from panicking.
Perhaps its rather roomy interior also helps alleviate feelings of pressure and claustrophobia.

items.name: Queen's Bracelets
items.description:
Bracelets indicating the highest order of sorcerer.
Worn by Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon.

When Rennala, head of both the Academy of Raya Lucaria and the Carian royal family, lost her husband Radagon, her heart went along with him.

And then, those at the academy realized. That Rennala was no champion, after all.

items.name: Queen's Crescent Crown
items.description:
A tall crown depicting the moon.
Worn by Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon. Increases intelligence.

When Rennala, head of both the Academy of Raya Lucaria and the Carian royal family, lost her husband Radagon, her heart went along with him.

And then, those at the academy realized. That Rennala was no champion, after all.

items.name: Queen's Leggings
items.description:
Leggings indicating the highest order of sorcerer.
Worn by Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon.

When Rennala, head of both the Academy of Raya Lucaria and the Carian royal family, lost her husband Radagon, her heart went along with him.

And then, those at the academy realized. That Rennala was no champion, after all.

items.name: Queen's Robe
items.description:
Robe indicating the highest order of sorcerer.
Worn by Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon.

When Rennala, head of both the Academy of Raya Lucaria and the Carian royal family, lost her husband Radagon, her heart went along with him.

And then, those at the academy realized. That Rennala was no champion, after all.

items.name: Radahn Soldier Gauntlets
items.description:
Gauntlets worn by soldiers who fought by General Radahn's side.
Rust-worn and stained through unending conflict.

items.name: Radahn Soldier Greaves
items.description:
Greaves worn by soldiers who fought by General Radahn's side.
Rust-worn and stained through unending conflict.

items.name: Radahn Soldier Helm
items.description:
Helm worn by soldiers who fought by General Radahn's side.
Its visor is fashioned after a lion's fangs.

items.name: Radahn's Gauntlets
items.description:
Gauntlets depicting the golden lion.
Worn by General Radahn.

The golden lion is said to symbolize Godfrey, the first Elden Lord, and his beast regent, Serosh. From his youngest years, Radahn was naturally captivated by the Lord of the Battlefield.

items.name: Radahn's Greaves
items.description:
Greaves depicting the golden lion.
Worn by General Radahn.

The golden lion is said to symbolize Godfrey, the first Elden Lord, and his beast regent, Serosh. From his youngest years, Radahn was naturally captivated by the Lord of the Battlefield.

items.name: Radahn's Lion Armor
items.description:
Armor depicting the golden lion.
Worn by General Radahn.

The golden lion is said to symbolize Godfrey, the first Elden Lord, and his beast regent, Serosh. From his youngest years, Radahn was naturally captivated by the Lord of the Battlefield.

items.name: Radahn's Lion Armor (Altered)
items.description:
Armor depicting the golden lion.
Worn by General Radahn.

The golden lion is said to symbolize Godfrey, the first Elden Lord, and his beast regent, Serosh. From his youngest years, Radahn was naturally captivated by the Lord of the Battlefield.

items.name: Radahn's Redmane Helm
items.description:
Helm of the golden lion, with flowing red hair.
Worn by General Radahn.

Radahn inherited the furious, flaming red hair of his father Radagon, and is fond of its heroic implications.

"I was born a champion's cub. Now I am the Lord of the Battlefield's lion."

items.name: Radiant Gold Mask
items.description:
A mask designed to resemble a blazing golden halo.
Created and left behind by Lord Goldmask, a staunch pursuer of Golden Order fundamentalism.

Strengthens Golden Order incantations.

Its striking design represents both the brilliant inspiration that once shone upon him, and the vision of a ring that he will surely find at the end of his pursuit.

"To you who seek to shine as I do, wear it well!"

items.name: Ragged Armor
items.description: Armor pieced together from scavenged metal.

items.name: Ragged Armor (Altered)
items.description: Armor pieced together from scavenged metal.

items.name: Ragged Gloves
items.description: Gauntlets pieced together from scavenged metal.

items.name: Ragged Hat
items.description: Helm pieced together from scavenged metal.

items.name: Ragged Hat (Altered)
items.description: Helm pieced together from scavenged metal.

items.name: Ragged Loincloth
items.description: Greaves pieced together from scavenged metal.

items.name: Raging Wolf Armor
items.description:
Armor worn by Vargram the Raging Wolf, one of the first Tarnished to visit the Roundtable Hold.

According to the old legends, wolves are the shadows of the Empyrean, and this is what Vargram aspired to be.

items.name: Raging Wolf Armor (Altered)
items.description:
Armor worn by Vargram the Raging Wolf, one of the first Tarnished to visit the Roundtable Hold.

According to the old legends, wolves are the shadows of the Empyrean, and this is what Vargram aspired to be.

items.name: Raging Wolf Gauntlets
items.description:
Gauntlets worn by Vargram the Raging Wolf, one of the first Tarnished to visit the Roundtable Hold.

According to the old legends, wolves are the shadows of the Empyrean, and this is what Vargram aspired to be.

items.name: Raging Wolf Greaves
items.description:
Greaves worn by Vargram the Raging Wolf, one of the first Tarnished to visit the Roundtable Hold.

According to the old legends, wolves are the shadows of the Empyrean, and this is what Vargram aspired to be.

items.name: Raging Wolf Helm
items.description:
Helm worn by Vargram the Raging Wolf, one of the first Tarnished to visit the Roundtable Hold.

Vargram's nickname comes from the white wolf's mane that decorates this helm.

items.name: Rakshasa Armor
items.description:
Armor of Rakshasa, soaked in the spurting blood of her victims. Tatters of ragged cloth jut out haphazardly, as if her lust for carnage threatens to break free.

Increases damage dealt to foes, but greatly increases damage taken by the wearer.

Cut down and devour. Only those who repeat the cycle without rest can truly subvert the self and become Rakshasa.

items.name: Rakshasa Gauntlets
items.description:
Gauntlets of Rakshasa, soaked in the spurting blood of her victims. Tatters of ragged cloth jut out haphazardly, as if her lust for carnage threatens to break free.

Increases damage dealt to foes, but greatly increases damage taken by the wearer.

Cut down and devour. Only those who repeat the cycle without rest can truly subvert the self and become Rakshasa.

items.name: Rakshasa Greaves
items.description:
Greaves of Rakshasa, soaked the spurting blood of her victims. Tatters of ragged cloth jut out haphazardly, as if her lust for carnage threatens to break free.

Increases damage dealt to foes, but greatly increases damage taken by the wearer.

Cut down and devour. Only those who repeat the cycle without rest can truly subvert the self and become Rakshasa.

items.name: Rakshasa Helm
items.description:
Helm of Rakshasa, soaked in the spurting blood of her victims. Tatters of ragged cloth jut out haphazardly, as if her lust for carnage threatens to break free.

Increases damage dealt to foes, but greatly increases damage taken by the wearer.

Cut down and devour. Only those who repeat the cycle without rest can truly subvert the self and become Rakshasa.

items.name: Raptor's Black Feathers
items.description:
Robe crafted with the black feathers of a bird of prey.
Worn by the assassins of Ravenmount.

A ritual implement for transforming into a Deathbird, if only by imitation.
Strengthens jump attacks.

"We are birds of prey, bringers of death."

items.name: Raya Lucarian Gauntlets
items.description:
Gauntlets worn by Raya Lucaria Academy soldiers.
Rust-worn and stained through unending conflict.

items.name: Raya Lucarian Greaves
items.description:
Greaves worn by Raya Lucaria Academy soldiers.
Rust-worn and stained through unending conflict.

items.name: Raya Lucarian Helm
items.description:
Helm worn by Raya Lucaria Academy soldiers.
Its brow is adorned with a single cuckoo's feather.

items.name: Raya Lucarian Robe
items.description:
Robe worn by Raya Lucaria's scholars of sorcery.

Those who dedicate themselves to the study of glintstones formed from starry amber receive this modest yet elegant deep navy garb after making their vows of virtue and austerity.

But with extended life, one is apt to forget old vows.

items.name: Redmane Knight Armor
items.description:
Armor worn by knights who fought by General Radahn's side.

When they were driven to defeat by Malenia's scarlet rot, the Redmane Knights burned the crest on the left breast of their armor to indicate their resolve.

"Alas, dear home, I shan't see you again! For our duty is to remain here, a bulwark against the blight."

items.name: Redmane Knight Armor (Altered)
items.description:
Armor worn by knights who fought by General Radahn's side.

When they were driven to defeat by Malenia's scarlet rot, the Redmane Knights burned the crest on the left breast of their armor to indicate their resolve.

"Alas, dear home, I shan't see you again! For our duty is to remain here, a bulwark against the blight."

items.name: Redmane Knight Gauntlets
items.description: Black iron gauntlets worn by knights who fought by General Radahn's side. Time has yet to dull their luster.

items.name: Redmane Knight Greaves
items.description: Black iron greaves worn by knights who fought by General Radahn's side. Time has yet to dull their luster.

items.name: Redmane Knight Helm
items.description:
Helm worn by knights who fought by General Radahn's side.

The red plume is a symbol of Radahn's pedigree as Lord Radagon's son—the mane of the proud Red Lion.

items.name: Redmane Surcoat
items.description:
Armor worn by soldiers who fought by General Radahn's side.

The surcoat depicts a red-maned lion raising a sword in the image of Radahn. Thus, they were Redmanes, and all proved they were worthy of the name.

items.name: Rellana's Armor
items.description:
Ornate armor of Rellana, the Twin Moon Knight, fashioned from silver steel.

Adorned with the lapis-lazuli blue that is symbolic of Caria, its radiance is yet to fully fade.

items.name: Rellana's Gloves
items.description: Gloves of Rellana, the Twin Moon Knight, fashioned from quality leather.

items.name: Rellana's Greaves
items.description: Ornate greaves of Rellana, the Twin Moon Knight, fashioned from silver steel.

items.name: Rellana's Helm
items.description:
Ornate helm of Rellana, the Twin Moon Knight, fashioned from silver steel.

Rennala, head of the royal family of Caria, was said to have given her younger sister, who renounced her lineage to chase after Messmer, a gift of lustrous black hair.

items.name: Ronin's Armor
items.description:
Armor of the man who calls himself Shabriri.
Highly functional and heavily worn.

The man, once known as Yura, kept a woman in the deepest reaches of his heart.

items.name: Ronin's Armor (Altered)
items.description:
Armor of the man who calls himself Shabriri.
Highly functional and heavily worn.

The man, once known as Yura, kept a woman in the deepest reaches of his heart.

items.name: Ronin's Gauntlets
items.description:
Gauntlets of the man who calls himself Shabriri.
Highly functional and heavily worn.

The man, once known as Yura, kept a woman in the deepest reaches of his heart.

items.name: Ronin's Greaves
items.description:
Greaves of the man who calls himself Shabriri.
Highly functional and heavily worn.

The man, once known as Yura, kept a woman in the deepest reaches of his heart.

items.name: Rotten Duelist Greaves
items.description:
Greaves wrapped with bronze snakes, eaten through by scarlet rot.

Worn by gladiators who were driven from the colosseum.
The wearer becomes a slightly easier target for foes.

items.name: Rotten Duelist Helm
items.description:
Bronze helm decorated with innumerable snakes, eaten through by scarlet rot.

Worn by gladiators who were driven from the colosseum.
The wearer becomes a slightly easier target for foes.

items.name: Rotten Gravekeeper Cloak
items.description:
Thick, bristly cloak eaten through by scarlet rot.

The symbol of an underground gravekeeper's station.

items.name: Rotten Gravekeeper Cloak (Altered)
items.description:
Cloak wrapped with bronze snakes, eaten through by scarlet rot.

Worn by gladiators who were driven from the colosseum.
The wearer becomes a slightly easier target for foes.

items.name: Royal Knight Armor
items.description:
Silver armor of Loretta, a knight who served Miquella's Haligtree.

Loretta was once a royal Carian knight, and her lapis-lazuli blue cape is the emblem of the knightly pride that continues to guide her.

items.name: Royal Knight Armor (Altered)
items.description:
Silver armor of Loretta, a knight who served Miquella's Haligtree.

Loretta, once a royal Carian knight, went on a journey in search of a haven for Albinaurics, and determined that the Haligtree was their best chance for eventual salvation.

items.name: Royal Knight Gauntlets
items.description:
Silver gauntlets of Loretta, a knight who served Miquella's Haligtree.

Loretta, once a royal Carian knight, went on a journey in search of a haven for Albinaurics, and determined that the Haligtree was their best chance for eventual salvation.

items.name: Royal Knight Greaves
items.description:
Silver greaves of Loretta, a knight who served Miquella's Haligtree.

Loretta, once a royal Carian knight, went on a journey in search of a haven for Albinaurics, and determined that the Haligtree was their best chance for eventual salvation.

items.name: Royal Knight Helm
items.description:
Silver helm of Loretta, a knight who served Miquella's Haligtree.

Loretta, once a royal Carian knight, went on a journey in search of a haven for Albinaurics, and determined that the Haligtree was their best chance for eventual salvation.

items.name: Royal Remains Armor
items.description:
Armor graced with gold human bones.
Worn by the unspeaking adherent of Sir Gideon the All-Knowing.

Slowly replenishes HP when HP is reduced.

It is said that the bones belong to an ancient lord―the soulless king. The lord of the lost and desperate, who was known as Ensha.

items.name: Royal Remains Gauntlets
items.description:
Gauntlets graced with gold human bones.
Worn by the unspeaking adherent of Sir Gideon the All-Knowing.

Slowly replenishes HP when HP is reduced.

It is said that the bones belong to an ancient lord―the soulless king. The lord of the lost and desperate, who was known as Ensha.

items.name: Royal Remains Greaves
items.description:
Greaves graced with gold human bones.
Worn by the unspeaking adherent of Sir Gideon the All-Knowing.

Slowly replenishes HP when HP is reduced.

It is said that the bones belong to an ancient lord―the soulless king. The lord of the lost and desperate, who was known as Ensha.

items.name: Royal Remains Helm
items.description:
Helm graced with gold human bones.
Worn by the unspeaking adherent of Sir Gideon the All-Knowing.

Slowly replenishes HP when HP is reduced.

It is said that the bones belong to an ancient lord―the soulless king. The lord of the lost and desperate, who was known as Ensha.

items.name: Ruler's Mask
items.description:
Mask in the image of a wizened sage.
Customary dress among lords in a smaller nation.
Increases faith.

Such a mask illustrates the qualities of an ideal lord: chiefly, wise and possessing a certain defanged geniality.
One at the center of society often finds these qualities most expedient.

items.name: Ruler's Robe
items.description:
Luxurious robe worn by lords in a smaller nation.
Its fine blue mantle serves to prove its wearer's status.

items.name: Sacred Crown Helm
items.description:
Flanged iron cap adorned with a crown of unalloyed gold.
Increases faith.

Worn by foot soldiers sworn to the Haligtree.

Who is it that Miquella shall bless, if not the low and the meek?

items.name: Sage Hood
items.description:
A burgundy pointed hood.
Attire of the wise sages who were deemed heretical.

Evidence that the wearer was driven from town.

items.name: Sage Robe
items.description:
Thick burgundy robe.
Attire of the wise sages who were deemed heretical.

Evidence that the wearer was driven from town.

items.name: Sage Trousers
items.description:
Thick burgundy trousers.
Attire of the wise sages who were deemed heretical.

Evidence that the wearer was driven from town.

items.name: Salza's Hood
items.description:
Hood of Salza, sage of the Fire Knights.

A prodigious amount of cloth wound around it, giving the impression of a greatly swollen head, and wearing it increases intelligence.

A disciple of the elder Wego, he refused to burn down an old ruin, at the risk of his own life.

items.name: Sanguine Noble Hood
items.description:
Hood of dyed black cloth featuring gold embroidery.
Worn by the nobles who serve the Lord of Blood.

Known to strike from pools of blood, these assassins are missionaries come to share the gospel of accursed blood.

items.name: Sanguine Noble Robe
items.description:
Robe of dyed black cloth featuring gold embroidery.
Worn by the nobles who serve the Lord of Blood.

The grand metallic pattern on the shoulder is a signifier of the noble rank they intend to claim upon the advent of the new dynasty they are working to install.

items.name: Sanguine Noble Waistcloth
items.description:
Waistcloth sewn from black cloth.
Worn by the nobles who serve the Lord of Blood.

Known to strike from pools of blood, these assassins are missionaries come to share the gospel of accursed blood.

items.name: Scale Armor
items.description:
Armor reinforced with small metal scales.

The cape covering the shoulders is made with treated rock lizard skin, and provides ample protection against fire.

items.name: Scaled Armor
items.description:
Armor worn by Old Knight Istvan.
The corroded metal is reinforced with rock-hard scales, making it highly effective against non-physical attacks.

Istvan is one of a few wizened Tarnished who survive to this day.

items.name: Scaled Armor (Altered)
items.description:
Armor worn by Old Knight Istvan.
The corroded metal is reinforced with rock-hard scales, making it highly effective against non-physical attacks.

Istvan is one of a few wizened Tarnished who survive to this day.

items.name: Scaled Gauntlets
items.description:
Gauntlets worn by Old Knight Istvan.
The corroded metal is reinforced with rock-hard scales, making it highly effective against non-physical attacks.

Istvan is one of a few wizened Tarnished who survive to this day.

items.name: Scaled Greaves
items.description:
Greaves worn by Old Knight Istvan.
The corroded metal is reinforced with rock-hard scales, making it highly effective against non-physical attacks.

Istvan is one of a few wizened Tarnished who survive to this day.

items.name: Scaled Helm
items.description:
Helm worn by Old Knight Istvan.
The corroded metal is reinforced with rock-hard scales, making it highly effective against non-physical attacks.

Istvan is one of a few wizened Tarnished who survive to this day.

items.name: Scarlet Tabard
items.description:
Padded cloth armor with the telltale stains of the scarlet rot.

Worn by foot soldiers in General Radahn's army.

items.name: Shadow Militiaman Armor
items.description:
Armor as dark as shadow, worn by vulgar militiamen.

Freshly-singed battlegrounds effusing with the stench of the dead. Forbidden lands that will be excised from the memory of history. What better place than the realms of shadow then, for such an army?

items.name: Shadow Militiaman Gauntlets
items.description:
Gauntlets as dark as shadow, worn by vulgar militiamen.

Freshly-singed battlegrounds effusing with the stench of the dead. Forbidden lands that will be excised from the memory of history. What better place than the realms of shadow then, for such an army?

items.name: Shadow Militiaman Greaves
items.description:
Greaves as dark as shadow, worn by vulgar militiamen.

Freshly-singed battlegrounds effusing with the stench of the dead. Forbidden lands that will be excised from the memory of history. What better place than the realms of shadow then, for such an army?

items.name: Shadow Militiaman Helm
items.description:
Helm as dark as shadow, worn by vulgar militiamen.

Freshly-singed battlegrounds effusing with the stench of the dead. Forbidden lands that will be excised from the memory of history. What better place than the realms of shadow then, for such an army?

items.name: Shaman Furs
items.description:
Raiment fashioned from a bristly pelt.
Worn by ancestral follower shamans.

The ancestral followers live a distance from the Erdtree, awaiting new buds. They are certain to sprout from their very flesh, and indeed, their souls.

items.name: Shaman Leggings
items.description:
Leggings fashioned from bristly pelts.
Worn by ancestral follower shamans.

The ancestral followers live a distance from the Erdtree, awaiting new buds. They are certain to sprout from their very flesh, and indeed, their souls.

items.name: Shining Horned Headband
items.description:
Headband decorated by a pair of shining horns.
Worn by ancestral follower shamans.

Horns with buds that also shine are ideal ceremonial items for ancestral worship. Strengthens Ancestral Infant's Head.

items.name: Silver Tear Mask
items.description:
Mask fashioned from the corpse of a formless Silver Tear, supported by its hardened, shed husk.

Greatly increases arcane to the detriment of physical attack power.

To imitate the imitator is a cunning play indeed.

items.name: Skeletal Mask
items.description:
Skeletal mask that tightly grips the face.
Worn by the assassins of Ravenmount.

This ritual implement relentlessly digs into the wearer's face, preserving one's human instincts while dressed in imitation of the Deathbirds.

items.name: Snow Witch Hat
items.description:
Witch's pointed hat, frigid and frozen through.
Of a style associated with practitioners of heretical sorcery.
Strengthens cold sorcery.

Once worn by the snowy crone who the young Ranni encountered deep in the woods. She was a witch, and well versed in cold sorceries.
It is said that the doll that houses Ranni's soul was modeled after her.

That old witch was Ranni's secret mentor.

items.name: Snow Witch Robe
items.description:
Witch's robe in the color of snow.

Once worn by the snowy crone who the young Ranni encountered deep in the woods. She was a witch, and well versed in cold sorceries.
It is said that the doll that houses Ranni's soul was modeled after her.

That old witch was Ranni's secret mentor.

items.name: Snow Witch Robe (Altered)
items.description:
Witch's robe in the color of snow.

Once worn by the snowy crone who the young Ranni encountered deep in the woods. She was a witch, and well versed in cold sorceries.
It is said that the doll that houses Ranni's soul was modeled after her.

That old witch was Ranni's secret mentor.

items.name: Snow Witch Skirt
items.description:
Witch's skirt in the color of snow.

Once worn by the snowy crone who the young Ranni encountered deep in the woods. She was a witch, and well versed in cold sorceries.
It is said that the doll that houses Ranni's soul was modeled after her.

That old witch was Ranni's secret mentor.

items.name: Soiled Loincloth
items.description: This lightly soiled loincloth of ragged cloth does little more than conceal one's nether regions.

items.name: Sorcerer Leggings
items.description:
Leggings worn by Raya Lucaria's scholars of sorcery.
Made by wrapping a simple cloth around the legs.

items.name: Sorcerer Manchettes
items.description:
Manchettes worn by Raya Lucaria's scholars of sorcery.
Made by wrapping a simple cloth around the forearms.

items.name: Spellblade's Gloves
items.description:
Glintstone sorcerer Rogier's gloves, graced with an intricate, aristocratic decoration. Strengthen glintstone sorcery skills.

Rogier spent his entire life behaving with utter detachment. No one noticed the anger, grief, regret, or fear that existed along with it.

items.name: Spellblade's Pointed Hat
items.description:
Glintstone sorcerer Rogier's pointed hat, a sign of a heretical practitioner. Strengthens glintstone sorcery skills.

Rogier spent his entire life behaving with utter detachment. No one noticed the anger, grief, regret, or fear that existed along with it.

items.name: Spellblade's Traveling Attire
items.description:
Glintstone sorcerer Rogier's traveling attire, graced with an intricate, aristocratic decoration. Strengthens glintstone sorcery skills.

Rogier spent his entire life behaving with utter detachment. No one noticed the anger, grief, regret, or fear that existed along with it.

items.name: Spellblade's Traveling Attire (Altered)
items.description:
Glintstone sorcerer Rogier's traveling attire, graced with an intricate, aristocratic decoration. Strengthens glintstone sorcery skills.

Rogier spent his entire life behaving with utter detachment. No one noticed the anger, grief, regret, or fear that existed along with it.

items.name: Spellblade's Trousers
items.description:
Glintstone sorcerer Rogier's trousers, graced with an intricate, aristocratic decoration. Strengthen glintstone sorcery skills.

Rogier spent his entire life behaving with utter detachment. No one noticed the anger, grief, regret, or fear that existed along with it.

items.name: St. Trina's Blossom
items.description:
St. Trina's life withered and fell, as fleeting as the seasons. At her last, she left a single water lily.

Slightly boosts max FP.

Despite the velvety-purple hue, the flower is in no way poisonous—it merely blooms in quietude.

items.name: Thiollier's Garb
items.description:
The dark attire of those who wield poison in secret.

The silver hair is arranged in the same style as St. Trina's, increasing arcane.

Additionally, countless needles are sewn onto the exterior, apparently for talismanic effect.

items.name: Thiollier's Garb (Altered)
items.description:
The dark attire of those who wield poison in secret.

Countless needles are sewn onto the exterior for talismanic effect.

items.name: Thiollier's Gloves
items.description: The dark gloves of those who wield poison in secret, ever scorned and loathed.

items.name: Thiollier's Mask
items.description:
A mask upon which is carved a tranquil sleeping face.

The silver hair is arranged in the same style as St. Trina's, increasing arcane.

Just once, Thiollier was granted the sweet repose of velvety sleep. The remainder of his days would be spent attempting to recapture it.

items.name: Thiollier's Trousers
items.description: The dark trousers of those who wield poison in secret, ever scorned and loathed.

items.name: Traveler's Boots
items.description:
Light yet sturdy leather boots.

Worn by young women who set off into the world to confront their fate.

items.name: Traveler's Clothes
items.description:
Light yet sturdy clothes.

Worn by young women who set off into the world to confront their fate.

items.name: Traveler's Gloves
items.description:
Gloves of a traveling perfumer of no renown.

An associate of a healer, he is said to be in search of new aromatics and flower gardens, in hopes of treating Misbegotten, Omen, and all those seen as impure.

items.name: Traveler's Hat
items.description:
Hat of a traveling perfumer of no renown.

An associate of a healer, he is said to be in search of new aromatics and flower gardens, in hopes of treating Misbegotten, Omen, and all those seen as impure.

items.name: Traveler's Manchettes
items.description:
Light yet sturdy leather manchettes.

Worn by young women who set off into the world to confront their fate.

items.name: Traveler's Slops
items.description:
Slops of a traveling perfumer of no renown.

An associate of a healer, he is said to be in search of new aromatics and flower gardens, in hopes of treating Misbegotten, Omen, and all those seen as impure.

items.name: Traveling Maiden Boots
items.description:
Boots worn by traveling maidens.

Maidens traversed the Lands Between for different reasons. Some to seek audience with the Fingers. Others, to find the Tarnished who they were destined to guide.

items.name: Traveling Maiden Gloves
items.description:
Gloves worn by traveling maidens.

Maidens traversed the Lands Between for different reasons. Some to seek audience with the Fingers. Others, to find the Tarnished who they were destined to guide.

items.name: Traveling Maiden Hood
items.description:

Maidens traversed the Lands Between for different reasons. Some to seek audience with the Fingers. Others, to find the Tarnished who they were destined to guide.

items.name: Traveling Maiden Robe
items.description:
Robe worn by traveling maidens.

Maidens traversed the Lands Between for different reasons. Some to seek audience with the Fingers. Others, to find the Tarnished who they were destined to guide.

items.name: Traveling Maiden Robe (Altered)
items.description: Modest garb of traveling maidens, typically worn under their robes.

items.name: Tree Sentinel Armor
items.description:
Golden armor of the heavy cavalry Tree Sentinels who serve the Erdtree.

Adorned with a cape featuring the mark of the sacred tree.

Imposingly sturdy and nigh unbreakable, the grace of old yet lingers.

items.name: Tree Sentinel Armor (Altered)
items.description:
Golden armor of the heavy cavalry Tree Sentinels who serve the Erdtree.

Imposingly sturdy and nigh unbreakable, the grace of old yet lingers.

items.name: Tree Sentinel Gauntlets
items.description:
Golden gauntlets of the heavy cavalry Tree Sentinels who serve the Erdtree.

Imposingly sturdy and nigh unbreakable, the grace of old yet lingers.

items.name: Tree Sentinel Greaves
items.description:
Golden greaves of the heavy cavalry Tree Sentinels who serve the Erdtree.

Imposingly sturdy and nigh unbreakable, the grace of old yet lingers.

items.name: Tree Sentinel Helm
items.description:
Golden helm of the heavy cavalry Tree Sentinels who serve the Erdtree.

Very few are permitted to wear a golden wood crest of such size as seen on this helm.

items.name: Tree Surcoat
items.description:
Blue surcoat draped over chainmail.

The tree insignia emblazoned on the front depicts the Erdtree, and is a design beloved throughout the Lands Between.

items.name: Tree-and-Beast Surcoat
items.description:
Armor worn by soldiers loyal to Godrick the Grafted.

The surcoat depicts the distant Erdtree and the beast regent, an emblem of the golden lineage.
Both are symbols of glory now past.

items.name: Twinned Armor
items.description:
Armor depicting entwined twins of gold and silver.

The two known as D are inseparable twins.
They are of two bodies and two minds, but one single soul. Not once do they stand together; not one word do they speak to one another.

Perhaps this armor longs to find its way to the other D.

items.description:

They are of two bodies and two minds, but one single soul. Not once do they stand together; not one word do they speak to one another.

items.description:

The two known as D are inseparable twins.
They are of two bodies and two minds, but one single soul. Not once do they stand together; not one word do they speak to one another.

items.name: Twinsage Glintstone Crown
items.description:
One of the glintstone crowns bestowed upon Raya Lucaria scholars whose pursuits were deemed worthy.

Greatly increases intelligence to the detriment of HP and stamina.

Scholars of the Twinsage Conspectus were the elites of the academy, permitted to study and excel in sorceries of all kinds.

items.name: Upper-Class Robe
items.description:
Embroidered, bright green robe worn by noble children.
Donning such a robe is traditionally the child's first show of burgeoning independence.

items.name: Vagabond Knight Armor
items.description:
Chest piece of a knight banished from their motherland.
Dirty and battered after enduring a lengthy vagabond journey.

The crest emblazoned on the front is worn and dingy, no longer able to evoke sentiment.

Metal armor is heavy, but also sturdy, offering significant damage negation.

items.name: Vagabond Knight Armor (Altered)
items.description:

Dirty and battered after enduring a lengthy vagabond journey.

The crest emblazoned on the front is worn and dingy, no longer able to evoke sentiment.

Metal armor is heavy, but also sturdy, offering significant damage negation.

items.description:
Gauntlets of a knight banished from their motherland.
Dirty and battered after enduring a lengthy vagabond journey.

Metal armor is heavy, but also sturdy, offering significant damage negation.

items.name: Vagabond Knight Greaves
items.description:

Dirty and battered after enduring a lengthy vagabond journey.

Metal armor is heavy, but also sturdy, offering significant damage negation.

items.name: Vagabond Knight Helm
items.description:
Helm of a knight banished from their motherland.
Dirty and battered after enduring a lengthy vagabond journey.

The visor is broken and can no longer be lowered.

Metal armor is heavy, but also sturdy, offering significant damage negation.

items.name: Verdigris Armor
items.description:
Chest armor made from an unusual metal known as verdigris.

Verdigris is said to be the gift of an outer god.
Possessed of an enormously hefty yet supple strength thanks to its rusted nature.

items.name: Verdigris Gauntlets
items.description:
Gauntlets made from an unusual metal known as verdigris.

Verdigris is said to be the gift of an outer god.
Possessed of an enormously hefty yet supple strength thanks to its rusted nature.

items.name: Verdigris Greaves
items.description:
Greaves made from an unusual metal known as verdigris.

Verdigris is said to be the gift of an outer god.
Possessed of an enormously hefty yet supple strength thanks to its rusted nature.

items.name: Verdigris Helm
items.description:
Helm made from an unusual metal known as verdigris.

Verdigris is said to be the gift of an outer god.
Possessed of an enormously hefty yet supple strength thanks to its rusted nature.

items.name: Veteran's Armor
items.description:
Old armor that has seen many battles.
Worn by Niall, the veteran general of Sol.

Niall was a lone survivor who commanded spirits to defend his long-passed master.

This aging general could not die, nor did he have anywhere to fade away.

items.name: Veteran's Armor (Altered)
items.description:

Worn by Niall, the veteran general of Sol.

Niall was a lone survivor who commanded spirits to defend his long-passed master.

This aging general could not die, nor did he have anywhere to fade away.
